+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+  pull_request:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  validate:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11"]
+
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
+          cache: pip
+
+      - name: Install package
+        run: python -m pip install -e .
+
+      - name: Run repository checks
+        run: make check PYTHON=python
+
+      - name: Run unit tests
+        run: make test PYTHON=python

+# Contributing
+
+Contributions should preserve the benchmark's task definitions, intervention budgets, and result provenance.
+
+1. Create a focused branch and keep generated data, model weights, checkpoints, logs, and credentials out of Git.
+2. Run `python scripts/validate_release.py`.
+3. Run `python analysis/validate_tasks.py`.
+4. For runner changes, execute the relevant `AUTOREP_DRY_RUN=1` command.
+5. Add or update tests when changing parsing, scoring, intervention validation, or result schemas.
+
+New tasks must include a `baseline.json`, an executable baseline adapter, an intervention adapter, a bounded search space derived from upstream resources, and an entry in `configs/tasks.json` and `configs/repositories.json`.

+PYTHON ?= python3
+
+.PHONY: check test
+
+check:
+	$(PYTHON) scripts/validate_release.py
+	$(PYTHON) analysis/validate_tasks.py
+	$(PYTHON) -m compileall -q agenthpobench analysis scripts tasks/main tasks/ablations/no_feedback baselines runners
+	find runners baselines tasks -type f -name '*.sh' -exec bash -n {} +
+	for method in random tpe bohb; do AUTOREP_DRY_RUN=1 bash runners/hpo/run_hpo_seed_phase.sh $$method 0 0 nonray; AUTOREP_DRY_RUN=1 bash runners/hpo/run_hpo_seed_phase.sh $$method 0 0 ray; done
+
+test:
+	$(PYTHON) -m unittest discover -s tests -v

@@ -0,0 +1,236 @@ +

AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers

+ +

+ +

+ +

+ +

+ +As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on static code generation, paper replication, or final answer correctness, but do not directly assess whether agents can interpret experimental evidence and use it to guide subsequent hyperparameter decisions. To address this gap, we introduce AgentHPOBench, a sequential benchmark comprising 30 executable machine learning tasks across seven research categories. Each task begins with a validated baseline run, after which an agent performs several sequential interventions. At each step, the agent observes the accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs before proposing the next valid configuration. We evaluate 12 widely used agents and conventional HPO baselines under a unified protocol. The results show that current agents exhibit measurable experimental optimization ability across domains, but still face clear limitations in sustained iterative refinement, complex log diagnosis, and consistent progress toward reported reference performance. + +## Benchmark Overview + +AgentHPOBench evaluates whether an autonomous agent can improve executable machine learning experiments through sequential hyperparameter interventions. The benchmark contains 30 repository-level tasks spanning language, vision, time series, graph learning, reinforcement learning, generative modeling, and structured learning. + +Each task provides: + +- a validated baseline configuration; +- a target metric and paper or repository reference; +- a constrained intervention space derived from official repository resources; +- an execution adapter for a baseline run and five sequential interventions; +- complete configuration, metric, log, and decision provenance in the result JSON. + +

+ +
+ AgentHPOBench task construction, sequential optimization protocol, and result auditing workflow. +

+ +## Benchmark Tasks and Upstream Repositories + +Each benchmark task is derived from a real research repository and runs against an audited, commit-pinned source snapshot. It stops on revision drift, unexpected +worktree changes, or a patch mismatch instead of silently reusing the directory. + +## Repository Layout + +```text +agenthpobench/ Core agent, execution, and evaluation code +agenthpobench/agents/open_weight/ Model-family-neutral local Transformers agent +tasks/main/ Main 30-task sequential intervention protocol +tasks/ablations/no_feedback/ No-intermediate-feedback task overlay +baselines/tpe/ TPE and Random Search task adapters +baselines/bohb/ BOHB-style task adapters +runners/ Multiseed and ablation launchers +analysis/ Result validation and leaderboard generation +configs/ Task, repository, and model manifests +results/summary/ Locally generated aggregate outputs +scripts/ Setup and release validation utilities +``` + +Third-party repositories, datasets, model weights, checkpoints, credentials, and runtime logs are intentionally excluded from Git. + +## Quick Start + +Create a base environment and install AgentHPOBench: + +```bash +git clone https://github.com/OpenMOSS/AgentHPOBench.git +cd AgentHPOBench +python3 -m venv .venv +source .venv/bin/activate +pip install -e ".[local,analysis,dev]" +``` + +Clone the upstream task repositories: + +```bash +python3 scripts/clone_repositories.py +``` + +Run the release and task-definition checks: + +```bash +make check +make test +``` + +The full benchmark is compute intensive and several tasks require their upstream repository's own environment, data license, or checkpoint. See [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md) and [docs/task-repositories.md](docs/task-repositories.md) before executing tasks. + +## Running Agents + +All local open-weight checkpoints use the model-family-neutral +`LocalTransformersAgent`; separate model-specific agent files are intentionally +unnecessary. The runners select each checkpoint, generation limit, and +chat-template behavior. The former `open_source.qwen_agent.QwenAgent` path +remains only as a compatibility alias. + +The runners accept a replicate seed and GPU index. They reject fallback decisions by default and preserve one result JSON per task. + +```bash +# Qwen3-32B, seed 1, GPU 0 +bash runners/qwen32/run_qwen32_seed.sh 1 0 + +# Open-weight model, seed 42, GPU 1 +bash runners/open_weight/run_model_seed.sh llama3_1_8b 42 1 + +# No-intermediate-feedback ablation +bash runners/no_feedback/run_qwen32_no_feedback_seed.sh 1 0 + +# Conventional HPO baselines: Random Search, TPE, and BOHB +bash runners/hpo/run_hpo_seed_queue.sh 1 0 + +# Run one baseline phase directly +bash runners/hpo/run_hpo_seed_phase.sh random 0 0 nonray +``` + +Use `AUTOREP_DRY_RUN=1` to validate task and model paths without launching experiments: + +```bash +AUTOREP_DRY_RUN=1 bash runners/qwen32/run_qwen32_seed.sh 1 0 +``` + +Model paths, task overlays, result roots, and selected task subsets can be overridden through environment variables documented in [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md). + +The `AUTOREP_*` variable prefix is retained as a compatibility interface for +the scripts used in the reported experiments. It does not refer to a separate +dependency or repository. + +## Result Integrity + +AgentHPOBench records the raw model response and decision metadata. A valid local-model result must have: + +- five completed interventions; +- `fallback_decision_count == 0`; +- nonempty raw responses attributed to the configured model; +- no task-level execution error. + +Validate a completed result directory with: + +```bash +python3 analysis/validate_results.py \ + results/qwen32_multiseed/qwen3_32b_seed1_final30 \ + --expected-seed 1 \ + --expected-model qwen3_32b +``` + +Strict validation requires an exact baseline-plus-five trace, exactly five +decisions and nonempty raw responses, a final metric, zero fallback markers, +no model or task error artifact, and the requested seed and model provenance. + +## Reproducing the Paper + +The paper uses the limited-budget protocol with one baseline run and five intervention opportunities. +"""Small dependency-free API client for AgentHPOBench decision agents."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+@dataclass
+class APIResponse:
+    text: str
+    metadata: dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _load_env_file() -> None:
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    candidates = []
+    if os.environ.get("AGENTHPOBENCH_ENV_FILE"):
+        candidates.append(Path(os.environ["AGENTHPOBENCH_ENV_FILE"]))
+    candidates.append(root / ".env")
+    for path in candidates:
+        if not path.exists():
+            continue
+        for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
+                continue
+            if line.startswith("export "):
+                line = line[len("export ") :].strip()
+            if "=" not in line:
+                continue
+            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
+            key = key.strip()
+            value = value.strip().strip("'\"")
+            if key and value and key not in os.environ:
+                os.environ[key] = value
+
+
+def api_backend_enabled() -> bool:
+    _load_env_file()
+    value = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND") or os.environ.get("AUTOREP_DECISION_BACKEND")
+    return str(value or "").strip().lower() in {
+        "api",
+        "openai",
+        "openai-compatible",
+        "anthropic",
+        "glm",
+        "claude_code",
+        "claude-code",
+        "codex",
+        "codex_cli",
+        "codex-cli",
+    }
+
+
+def api_model_name(default: str = "api-model") -> str:
+    _load_env_file()
+    return os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_MODEL") or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL") or default
+
+
+def _read_timeout() -> float:
+    return float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_TIMEOUT", "120"))
+
+
+def _temperature(default: float) -> float:
+    return float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_TEMPERATURE", str(default)))
+
+
+def _max_tokens(default: int) -> int:
+    return int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_MAX_TOKENS", str(default)))
+
+
+def _request_retries() -> int:
+    return max(1, int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_RETRIES", "5")))
+
+
+def _env_flag(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
+    value = os.environ.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        return default
+    return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled", "enable"}
+
+
+def _message_content_text(message: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    content = message.get("content", "")
+    if not content and message.get("reasoning_content"):
+        content = message.get("reasoning_content", "")
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        return content
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        parts = []
+        for item in content:
+            if isinstance(item, dict):
+                parts.append(str(item.get("text") or item.get("content") or ""))
+            else:
+                parts.append(str(item))
+        return "".join(parts)
+    return str(content or "")
+
+
+def _request_json(url: str, headers: dict[str, str], payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+    try:
+        import requests as requests_client
+    except Exception:
+        requests_client = None
+
+    last_exc: BaseException | None = None
+    for attempt in range(_request_retries()):
+        try:
+            if requests_client is not None:
+                resp = requests_client.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=_read_timeout())
+                raw = resp.text
+                if resp.status_code >= 400:
+                    raise RuntimeError(f"API HTTP {resp.status_code}: {raw[:2000]}")
+                return resp.json()
+
+            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST")
+            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=_read_timeout()) as resp:
+                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            return json.loads(raw)
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+            raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            raise RuntimeError(f"API HTTP {exc.code}: {raw[:2000]}") from exc
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            text = str(exc)
+            if text.startswith("API HTTP "):
+                code_text = text.split(":", 1)[0].split()[-1]
+                code = int(code_text) if code_text.isdigit() else 0
+                if code not in {408, 409, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}:
+                    raise
+            last_exc = exc
+        except Exception as exc:
+            last_exc = exc
+        if attempt + 1 < _request_retries():
+            time.sleep(min(2.0 * (attempt + 1), 10.0))
+    raise RuntimeError(f"API connection error after {_request_retries()} attempts: {last_exc}") from last_exc
+
+def _provider() -> str:
+    _load_env_file()
+    value = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_PROVIDER") or os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND") or "openai"
+    value = value.strip().lower()
+    if value in {"api", "openai-compatible"}:
+        return "openai"
+    return value
+
+
+def _openai_compatible(prompt: str, *, temperature: float, max_tokens: int) -> APIResponse:
+    _load_env_file()
+    provider = _provider()
+    api_key = (
+        os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+        or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+        or (os.environ.get("ZHIPUAI_API_KEY") if provider == "glm" else None)
+    )
+    if not api_key:
+        if provider == "glm":
+            raise RuntimeError("Missing ZHIPUAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY or AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+    if provider == "glm":
+        default_base_url = "https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4"
+        base_url = (
+            os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL")
+            or os.environ.get("ZHIPUAI_BASE_URL")
+            or os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL")
+            or default_base_url
+        ).rstrip("/")
+        model = api_model_name("glm-4-flash")
+    else:
+        base_url = (os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL") or os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or "https://api.openai.com/v1").rstrip("/")
+        model = api_model_name()
+    url = f"{base_url}/chat/completions"
+    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": model,
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+        "temperature": temperature,
+        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+    }
+    if provider == "glm" and not _env_flag("AUTOREP_API_GLM_THINKING", default=False):
+        payload["thinking"] = {"type": "disabled"}
+    if os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_EXTRA_BODY"):
+        payload.update(json.loads(os.environ["AUTOREP_API_EXTRA_BODY"]))
+    headers = {
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+    }
+    started = time.time()
+    data = _request_json(url, headers, payload)
+    message = data["choices"][0].get("message") or {}
+    text = _message_content_text(message).strip()
+    return APIResponse(
+        text=text,
+        metadata={
+            "provider": "openai",
+            "api_provider": provider,
+            "model": model,
+            "base_url": base_url,
+            "usage": data.get("usage"),
+            "api_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _anthropic(prompt: str, *, temperature: float, max_tokens: int) -> APIResponse:
+    _load_env_file()
+    api_key = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+    base_url = (os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL") or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL") or "https://api.anthropic.com").rstrip("/")
+    url = f"{base_url}/v1/messages"
+    model = api_model_name("claude-3-5-sonnet-latest")
+    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": model,
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+        "temperature": temperature,
+        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "x-api-key": api_key,
+        "anthropic-version": os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_VERSION", "2023-06-01"),
+    }
+    started = time.time()
+    data = _request_json(url, headers, payload)
+    parts = data.get("content") or []
+    text = "\n".join(part.get("text", "") for part in parts if part.get("type") == "text").strip()
+    return APIResponse(
+        text=text,
+        metadata={
+            "provider": "anthropic",
+            "model": model,
+            "base_url": base_url,
+            "usage": data.get("usage"),
+            "api_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _redact_secret(text: str) -> str:
+    for key in (
+        "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN",
+        "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
+        "AUTOREP_API_KEY",
+        "OPENAI_API_KEY",
+        "OPENAI_BASE_URL",
+        "AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL",
+        "ZHIPUAI_API_KEY",
+    ):
+        value = os.environ.get(key)
+        if value:
+            text = text.replace(value, "[REDACTED]")
+    return text
+
+
+def _codex_cli(prompt: str, *, temperature: float, max_tokens: int) -> APIResponse:
+    """Call Codex CLI as a decision harness and return its final message.
+
+    We keep the experiment execution in AgentHPOBench and use Codex only for the
+    intervention decision. This mirrors the Claude Code path while isolating
+    results under a separate harness-ablation slug.
+    """
+
+    _load_env_file()
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY or AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+    base_url = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL")
+    codex_bin = (
+        os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CODEX_BIN")
+        or shutil.which("codex")
+        or str(root / "external" / "npm-global" / "bin" / "codex")
+    )
+    if not codex_bin or not Path(codex_bin).exists():
+        raise RuntimeError("Codex CLI not found; install @openai/codex or set AUTOREP_CODEX_BIN")
+
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    env["OPENAI_API_KEY"] = api_key
+    if base_url:
+        env["OPENAI_BASE_URL"] = base_url
+    node_bin = root / "external" / "node-v20.11.1-linux-x64" / "bin"
+    npm_bin = root / "external" / "npm-global" / "bin"
+    env["PATH"] = f"{node_bin}:{npm_bin}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
+
+    model = api_model_name(os.environ.get("CODEX_MODEL", "gpt-5.1-codex"))
+    timeout = float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CODEX_TIMEOUT", str(_read_timeout())))
+    retries = max(1, int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CODEX_RETRIES", str(_request_retries()))))
+    started = time.time()
+    last_error = ""
+    harness_prompt = (
+        "You are acting as an AgentHPOBench intervention decision harness. "
+        "Do not modify files, do not run commands, and do not explain outside JSON. "
+        "Return exactly one JSON object containing only proposed hyperparameter keys and values.\n\n"
+        + prompt
+    )
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="autorep_codex_") as tmp:
+        out_path = Path(tmp) / "last_message.txt"
+        for attempt in range(retries):
+            cmd = [
+                codex_bin,
+                "exec",
+                "--skip-git-repo-check",
+                "--ephemeral",
+                "--ignore-rules",
+                "--sandbox",
+                "read-only",
+                "--cd",
+                str(root),
+                "--output-last-message",
+                str(out_path),
+                "--color",
+                "never",
+                "--model",
+                model,
+                "-",
+            ]
+            try:
+                proc = subprocess.run(
+                    cmd,
+                    cwd=str(root),
+                    env=env,
+                    input=harness_prompt.encode("utf-8"),
+                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                    stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+                    timeout=timeout,
+                    check=False,
+                )
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+                stdout = (exc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+                stderr = (exc.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+                last_error = f"Codex CLI timed out after {timeout}s: {_redact_secret(stdout + stderr)[-2000:]}"
+                if attempt + 1 < retries:
+                    time.sleep(min(10.0 * (attempt + 1), 30.0))
+                    continue
+                raise RuntimeError(last_error)
+
+            stdout = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            stderr = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            text = out_path.read_text(errors="replace").strip() if out_path.exists() else stdout.strip()
+            if proc.returncode == 0 and text:
+                return APIResponse(
+                    text=text,
+                    metadata={
+                        "provider": "codex",
+                        "model": model,
+                        "base_url": base_url,
+                        "api_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
+                    },
+                )
+            last_error = f"Codex CLI failed rc={proc.returncode}: {_redact_secret((stdout + stderr)[-2000:])}"
+            if attempt + 1 < retries:
+                time.sleep(min(10.0 * (attempt + 1), 30.0))
+                continue
+            raise RuntimeError(last_error)
+    raise RuntimeError(last_error or "Codex CLI failed without response")
+
+
+def _claude_code_cli(prompt: str, *, temperature: float, max_tokens: int) -> APIResponse:
+    """Call Claude Code CLI for Claude-Code OAuth/token gateways.
+
+    Claude Code tokens such as sk-ant-oat... are not regular Anthropic API keys.
+    The official CLI handles the required auth path, so this backend shells out
+    to `claude -p` and returns the printed result as the decision text.
+    """
+
+    _load_env_file()
+    token = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
+    if not token:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or AUTOREP_API_KEY")
+    base_url = (os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL") or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/")
+    if not base_url:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing AUTOREP_API_BASE_URL or ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL")
+
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    node_bin = root / "external" / "node-v20.11.1-linux-x64" / "bin"
+    npm_bin = root / "external" / "npm-global" / "bin"
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"] = base_url
+    env["ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN"] = token
+    env.pop("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", None)
+    env["DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
+    env["DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING"] = "1"
+    env["CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC"] = "1"
+    env["CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR"] = "1"
+    env["PATH"] = f"{node_bin}:{npm_bin}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
+
+    model = api_model_name("sonnet")
+    budget = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_BUDGET_USD", "1.00")
+    started = time.time()
+    retries = max(1, int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CLAUDE_CODE_RETRIES", str(_request_retries()))))
+    timeout = float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_CLAUDE_CODE_TIMEOUT", str(_read_timeout())))
+    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+    last_error = ""
+    for attempt in range(retries):
+        cmd = [
+            "claude",
+            "-p",
+            prompt,
+            "--model",
+            model,
+            "--output-format",
+            "json",
+            "--max-budget-usd",
+            budget,
+            "--tools",
+            "",
+        ]
+        try:
+            proc = subprocess.run(
+                cmd,
+                cwd=str(root),
+                env=env,
+                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+                timeout=timeout,
+                check=False,
+            )
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+            stdout = (exc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            stderr = (exc.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            last_error = f"Claude Code timed out after {timeout}s: {_redact_secret(stdout + stderr)[-2000:]}"
+            if attempt + 1 < retries:
+                time.sleep(min(10.0 * (attempt + 1), 30.0))
+                continue
+            raise RuntimeError(last_error)
+
+        stdout = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        stderr = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            data = json.loads(stdout)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
+            last_error = f"Claude Code returned non-JSON output: {_redact_secret((stdout + stderr)[-2000:])}"
+            if attempt + 1 < retries:
+                time.sleep(min(10.0 * (attempt + 1), 30.0))
+                continue
+            raise RuntimeError(last_error) from exc
+        if proc.returncode == 0 and not data.get("is_error"):
+            break
+        last_error = f"Claude Code failed rc={proc.returncode}: {_redact_secret(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)[:2000])}"
+        if attempt + 1 < retries and any(token in last_error for token in ("ECONNRESET", "Unable to connect", "timed out", "ETIMEDOUT", "ECONNREFUSED")):
+            time.sleep(min(10.0 * (attempt + 1), 30.0))
+            continue
+        raise RuntimeError(last_error)
+    if data is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(last_error or "Claude Code failed without response")
+    text = str(data.get("result") or "").strip()
+    return APIResponse(
+        text=text,
+        metadata={
+            "provider": "claude_code",
+            "model": model,
+            "base_url": base_url,
+            "usage": data.get("usage"),
+            "api_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
+            "total_cost_usd": data.get("total_cost_usd"),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def call_decision_api(prompt: str, *, temperature: float = 0.0, max_tokens: int = 384) -> APIResponse:
+    _load_env_file()
+    provider = _provider()
+    temperature = _temperature(temperature)
+    max_tokens = _max_tokens(max_tokens)
+    if provider in {"codex", "codex_cli", "codex-cli"}:
+        return _codex_cli(prompt, temperature=temperature, max_tokens=max_tokens)
+    if provider in {"claude_code", "claude-code"}:
+        return _claude_code_cli(prompt, temperature=temperature, max_tokens=max_tokens)
+    if provider == "anthropic":
+        return _anthropic(prompt, temperature=temperature, max_tokens=max_tokens)
+    return _openai_compatible(prompt, temperature=temperature, max_tokens=max_tokens)

+"""
+Anthropic SDK agent for AgentHPOBench.
+Supports custom base_url for routing through a local proxy (gpu_http_proxy).
+"""
+
+import os
+import time
+import json
+from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
+
+from agenthpobench.core.agent_base import Agent, DecisionContext, AgentDecision, InvalidDecisionError
+
+
+class AnthropicAgent(Agent):
+    """Agent using Anthropic SDK, with optional base_url for proxy support."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model: str = "claude-sonnet-4-6",
+        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
+        base_url: Optional[str] = None,
+        temperature: float = 0.7,
+        max_tokens: int = 1500,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(
+            name="AnthropicAgent",
+            model_name=model,
+            temperature=temperature,
+            max_tokens=max_tokens,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        self.model = model
+        self.temperature = temperature
+        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
+
+        api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "dummy")
+
+        try:
+            from anthropic import Anthropic
+            kwargs_client: Dict[str, Any] = {"api_key": api_key}
+            if base_url:
+                kwargs_client["base_url"] = base_url
+            self.client = Anthropic(**kwargs_client)
+        except ImportError:
+            print("Warning: anthropic package not installed.")
+            self.client = None
+
+    def decide(self, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        if self.client is None:
+            return self._fallback_decision(context)
+
+        prompt = self._build_prompt(context)
+        max_retries = 5
+        retry_delay = 10.0
+        for attempt in range(1, max_retries + 1):
+            try:
+                response = self.client.messages.create(
+                    model=self.model,
+                    max_tokens=self.max_tokens,
+                    temperature=self.temperature,
+                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+                )
+                text = response.content[0].text

+"""
+GLM (Zhipu AI) agent implementation for AgentHPOBench.
+
+Supports both GLM-4 and other models via Zhipu AI API.

+
+import os
+import time
+from typing import Dict, Any
+
+from agenthpobench.core.agent_base import Agent, DecisionContext, AgentDecision, InvalidDecisionError
+
+
+class GLMAgent(Agent):
+    """Agent using GLM API via Zhipu AI."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model: str = "glm-4-flash",
+        temperature: float = 0.7,
+        max_tokens: int = 2000,
+        api_key: str | None = None,
+        **kwargs
+    ):
+        """
+        Initialize GLM agent.
+
+        Args:
+            model: Model to use (e.g., "glm-4-flash", "glm-4-plus", "glm-4-air")
+                   Available models:
+                   - glm-4-flash: Fast, cost-effective (best for testing)
+                   - glm-4-plus: Most capable
+                   - glm-4-air: Balanced performance
+            temperature: Sampling temperature (0-1)
+            max_tokens: Maximum tokens in response
+            api_key: Zhipu AI API key (defaults to ZHIPUAI_API_KEY env var)
+        """
+        super().__init__(
+            name="GLM",
+            model_name=model,
+            temperature=temperature,
+            max_tokens=max_tokens,
+            **kwargs
+        )
+
+        self.model = model
+        self.temperature = temperature
+        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
+
+        # Initialize client
+        api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("ZHIPUAI_API_KEY")
+        if not api_key:
+            raise ValueError("ZHIPUAI_API_KEY environment variable must be set")
+
+        self.api_key = api_key
+        try:
+            from zhipuai import ZhipuAI
+            self.client = ZhipuAI(api_key=api_key)
+        except ImportError:
+            print("Warning: zhipuai package not installed. Run: pip install zhipuai")
+            self.client = None
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"Warning: Failed to initialize GLM client: {e}")
+            self.client = None
+
+    def decide(self, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        """Make a decision using GLM API."""
+
+        if self.client is None:
+            # Fallback: return a simple rule-based decision
+            return self._fallback_decision(context)
+
+        # Build prompt
+        prompt = self._build_prompt(context)
+
+        start_time = time.time()
+        timeout_seconds = 60  # 1 minute timeout
+
+        try:
+            # Call API with timeout using threads
+            import threading
+
+            response_container = {}
+            error_container = {}
+
+            def api_call():
+                try:
+                    response_container['result'] = self.client.chat.completions.create(
+                        model=self.model,
+                        messages=[
+                            {
+                                "role": "user",
+                                "content": prompt,
+                            }
+                        ],
+                        temperature=self.temperature,
+                        max_tokens=self.max_tokens,
+                    )
+                except Exception as e:
+                    error_container['error'] = e
+
+            # Start API call in a separate thread
+            api_thread = threading.Thread(target=api_call)
+            api_thread.daemon = True
+            api_thread.start()
+            api_thread.join(timeout=timeout_seconds)
+
+            if api_thread.is_alive():
+                print(f"GLM API timeout after {timeout_seconds}s")
+                return self._fallback_decision(context)
+
+            if 'error' in error_container:
+                raise error_container['error']
+
+            response = response_container['result']
+            elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
+
+            # Estimate cost
+            prompt_tokens = response.usage.prompt_tokens
+            completion_tokens = response.usage.completion_tokens
+            cost = self._estimate_cost(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
+            self.total_cost += cost
+
+            # Parse response
+            response_text = response.choices[0].message.content
+            decision = self._parse_response(response_text, context)
+
+            return decision
+
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"GLM API error: {e}")
+            return self._fallback_decision(context)
+
+    def _fallback_decision(self, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        """Fallback rule-based decision if API fails."""
+        # Simple heuristic: reduce learning rate if validation acc is not improving

+            prev_acc = metrics_history[-2][1].get("accuracy", 0.0)

+            if recent_acc <= prev_acc:

+                current_lr = context.current_config.get("learning_rate", 0.001)

+3. **优化器**: 不同优化器适合不同任务
+4. **正则化**: 如果过拟合（训练准确率 >> 验证准确率），增加正则化

+- 如果训练进展良好，可以保持当前值

+- 只返回搜索空间内的有效超参数值
+

+请按以下格式返回：
+
+```
+推理: [你的解释，说明训练状况和为什么做这些调整]
+
+新配置:
+{{
+    "learning_rate": 0.05,
+    "batch_size": 128,
+    "optimizer": "sgd",
+    ...
+}}
+
+置信度: 0.8
+```
+
+请现在做出决策：
+"""
+        return prompt
+
+    def _parse_response(self, response: str, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        """Parse the agent's response."""
+
+        try:
+            # Extract reasoning (handle Chinese key)
+            reasoning_start = response.find("推理:")
+            if reasoning_start == -1:
+                reasoning_start = response.find("REASONING:")
+
+            reasoning_end = response.find("新配置:")
+            if reasoning_end == -1:
+                reasoning_end = response.find("NEW_CONFIG:")
+
+            reasoning = response[reasoning_start + 3:reasoning_end].strip()
+
+            # Extract config
+            config_start = response.find("{")
+            config_end = response.rfind("}") + 1
+            config_str = response[config_start:config_end]
+
+            import json
+
+            new_config = json.loads(config_str)
+
+            # Extract confidence
+            confidence_start = response.find("置信度:")
+            if confidence_start == -1:
+                confidence_start = response.find("CONFIDENCE:")
+
+            confidence_str = response[confidence_start + 4:].strip()
+            confidence = float(confidence_str)
+
+            # Validate
+            is_valid, error_msg = self.validate_decision(new_config, context.search_space)
+            if not is_valid:
+                raise InvalidDecisionError(f"Invalid config: {error_msg}")
+
+            return AgentDecision(
+                new_config=new_config,
+                reasoning=reasoning,
+                confidence=confidence,
+                metadata={"raw_response": response},
+            )
+
+        except Exception as e:
+            raise InvalidDecisionError(f"Failed to parse response: {e}")
+
+    def _format_config(self, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+        """Format config for display."""
+        return "\n".join([f"  {k}: {v}" for k, v in config.items()])
+
+    def _format_search_space(self, search_space: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+        """Format search space for display."""
+        lines = []
+        for param, range_def in search_space.items():
+            if isinstance(range_def, list):
+                lines.append(f"- {param}: {range_def}")
+            elif isinstance(range_def, dict):
+                if "min" in range_def and "max" in range_def:
+                    scale = range_def.get("scale", "linear")
+                    lines.append(f"- {param}: [{range_def['min']}, {range_def['max']}] ({scale} scale)")
+                else:
+                    lines.append(f"- {param}: {range_def}")
+
+        return "\n".join(lines)
+
+    def _estimate_cost(self, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int) -> float:
+        """Estimate API cost in CNY (GLM pricing)."""
+        # GLM-4 pricing (as of 2024, in CNY)
+        # Source: https://open.bigmodel.cn/pricing
+        pricing = {
+            "glm-4-flash": {"input": 0.0001, "output": 0.0001},  # 0.1元/1M tokens
+            "glm-4-plus": {"input": 0.01, "output": 0.01},  # 10元/1M tokens
+            "glm-4-air": {"input": 0.001, "output": 0.001},  # 1元/1M tokens
+            "glm-3-turbo": {"input": 0.0005, "output": 0.0005},  # 0.5元/1M tokens
+        }
+
+        if self.model not in pricing:
+            # Default to flash pricing
+            rates = pricing["glm-4-flash"]
+        else:
+            rates = pricing[self.model]
+
+        # Convert from yuan/1M to yuan/token
+        input_cost = input_tokens * rates["input"] / 1e6
+        output_cost = output_tokens * rates["output"] / 1e6
+
+        return input_cost + output_cost

+            decision = self._parse_response(response_text, context)
+            decision.metadata.update(
+                {
+                    "model_path": self.model_path,
+                    "api_backend": bool(getattr(self, "api_backend", False)),
+                    "api_model": getattr(self, "api_model", None),

+                {

+                    "api_model": getattr(self, "api_model", None),
+                    "api": getattr(self, "_last_api_metadata", None),
+                    "raw_response": response_text[:4000],

+            if not getattr(self, "api_backend", False):

+    def _resolve_dtype(self, torch_dtype: str):
+        if not torch_dtype:
+            return None
+        value = str(torch_dtype).strip().lower()
+        if value == "auto":
+            if torch.cuda.is_available():
+                return torch.bfloat16
+            return None
+        return getattr(torch, value, None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve_metric_direction(context: DecisionContext) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        """Return the optimization verb and reader-facing metric direction."""
+        explicit = str(getattr(context, "metric_direction", "") or "").strip().lower()
+        lower_aliases = {
+            "lower",
+            "lower_is_better",
+            "lower is better",
+            "minimize",
+            "minimise",
+        }
+        higher_aliases = {
+            "higher",
+            "higher_is_better",
+            "higher is better",
+            "maximize",
+            "maximise",
+        }
+        if explicit in lower_aliases:
+            return "minimize", "lower is better"
+        if explicit in higher_aliases:
+            return "maximize", "higher is better"
+
+        log_text = str(context.training_log or "").lower()
+        candidates = []
+        for marker in ("lower is better", "lower_is_better"):
+            position = log_text.find(marker)
+            if position >= 0:
+                candidates.append((position, "minimize", "lower is better"))
+        for marker in ("higher is better", "higher_is_better"):
+            position = log_text.find(marker)
+            if position >= 0:
+                candidates.append((position, "maximize", "higher is better"))
+        if candidates:
+            _, objective, direction = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
+            return objective, direction
+
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Metric direction is required. Set DecisionContext.metric_direction "
+            "to higher_is_better or lower_is_better."
+        )
+
+    def _build_prompt(self, context: DecisionContext) -> str:
+        optimization_goal, metric_direction = self._resolve_metric_direction(context)
+        return f"""You are an expert machine learning researcher helping optimize hyperparameters for model training.
+
+## Task
+Optimize hyperparameters to {optimization_goal} the target metric within the remaining budget.
+- Metric Direction: {metric_direction}
+
+## Current Training Progress
+- Current Epoch: {context.epoch}
+- Budget Remaining: {context.budget_remaining} epochs (out of {context.total_budget} total)
+- Decision Number: {context.decision_number + 1}
+
+## Recent Training Logs
+```
+{context.training_log}
+```
+
+## Current Hyperparameters
+```
+{self._format_config(context.current_config)}
+```
+
+## Hyperparameter Search Space
+{self._format_search_space(context.search_space)}
+
+## Instructions
+- Be conservative unless the run is clearly plateauing or unstable.
+- Only return values inside the search space.
+- If training is improving normally, keeping the current config is acceptable.
+- Output plain text only. Do not use markdown code fences, XML tags, or extra sections.
+- Follow the exact headers below.
+
+## Response Format
+REASONING: <short explanation>
+NEW_CONFIG: {{"learning_rate": 0.05, "batch_size": 128, "optimizer": "sgd"}}
+CONFIDENCE: 0.8
+"""

+            try:

+                    messages,
+                    tokenize=False,
+                    add_generation_prompt=True,

+                    "AUTOREP_LOCAL_MODEL_NO_THINK",
+                    legacy_name="AUTOREP_QWEN_NO_THINK",
+                )
+                # DeepSeek-R1-Distill templates always prefill an open thinking
+                # block and ignore enable_thinking=False. Close that block and
+                # prefill the JSON object so generation starts with config fields.
+                if no_think and rendered.rstrip().endswith("<think>"):
+                    self._response_prefix = "NEW_CONFIG: {"
+                    return rendered.rstrip() + "\n</think>\n\n" + self._response_prefix
+                force_prefix = os.environ.get(
+                    "AUTOREP_FORCE_CONFIG_PREFIX", "0"
+                ).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+                if force_prefix:
+                    self._response_prefix = "NEW_CONFIG: {"
+                    return rendered.rstrip() + "\n" + self._response_prefix
+                return rendered
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        force_prefix = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_FORCE_CONFIG_PREFIX", "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+        if force_prefix:
+            self._response_prefix = "NEW_CONFIG: {"
+            return prompt.rstrip() + chr(10) + self._response_prefix
+        return prompt
+
+    def _generate(self, prompt: str) -> str:
+        if getattr(self, "api_backend", False):
+            response = call_decision_api(prompt, temperature=self.temperature, max_tokens=self.max_new_tokens)
+            self._last_api_metadata = response.metadata
+            return response.text.strip()
+
+        if _env_flag(
+            "AUTOREP_LOCAL_MODEL_NO_THINK",
+            legacy_name="AUTOREP_QWEN_NO_THINK",
+        ):
+            prompt = prompt + "\n/no_think\nDo not output thinking. Start immediately with REASONING."
+        rendered_prompt = self._render_prompt(prompt)
+        inputs = self.tokenizer(rendered_prompt, return_tensors="pt")
+        try:
+            device = getattr(self.model, "device", None)
+            if device is not None:
+                inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+        do_sample = self.temperature > 0
+        generation_kwargs = {
+            "max_new_tokens": self.max_new_tokens,
+            "do_sample": do_sample,
+            "pad_token_id": self.tokenizer.pad_token_id,
+            "eos_token_id": self.tokenizer.eos_token_id,

+        if do_sample:

+        else:

+    def _strip_code_fences(self, text: str) -> str:
+        text = text.strip()
+        if text.startswith("```"):
+            lines = text.splitlines()
+            if lines and lines[0].startswith("```"):
+                lines = lines[1:]
+            if lines and lines[-1].strip() == "```":
+                lines = lines[:-1]
+            text = "\n".join(lines).strip()
+        return text
+
+    def _extract_json_block(self, text: str, anchor: str = "NEW_CONFIG:") -> str:
+        text = self._strip_code_fences(text)
+        anchor_pos = text.find(anchor)
+        if anchor_pos == -1:
+            anchor_pos = 0
+        brace_start = text.find("{", anchor_pos)
+        if brace_start == -1:
+            raise ValueError("Missing JSON object in model response")
+
+        depth = 0
+        for idx in range(brace_start, len(text)):
+            ch = text[idx]
+            if ch == "{":
+                depth += 1
+            elif ch == "}":
+                depth -= 1
+                if depth == 0:
+                    return text[brace_start : idx + 1]
+        raise ValueError("Unterminated JSON object in model response")
+
+    def _loads_config_block(self, block: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        normalized = block.translate(
+            str.maketrans(
+                {
+                    "\u201c": '"',
+                    "\u201d": '"',
+                    "\u2018": "'",
+                    "\u2019": "'",
+                    "\uff1a": ":",
+                    "\uff0c": ",",
+                }
+            )
+        )
+        try:
+            return json.loads(normalized)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            normalized = re.sub(r"\bTrue\b", "true", normalized)
+            normalized = re.sub(r"\bFalse\b", "false", normalized)
+            normalized = re.sub(r"\bNone\b", "null", normalized)
+            try:
+                return json.loads(normalized)
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                # Some local models emit JSON-like mappings with unquoted
+                # identifier keys or enum values. Normalize only those tokens;
+                # the resulting values are still validated against the task
+                # search space before execution.
+                relaxed = re.sub(
+                    r'([{,]\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)(\s*:)',
+                    r'\1"\2"\3',
+                    normalized,
+                )
+
+                def quote_bare_value(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+                    prefix, value, suffix = match.groups()
+                    if value in {"true", "false", "null"}:
+                        return match.group(0)
+                    return f'{prefix}"{value}"{suffix}'
+
+                relaxed = re.sub(
+                    r'(:\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_./:+-]*)(\s*[,}])',
+                    quote_bare_value,
+                    relaxed,
+                )
+                relaxed = re.sub(r",\s*}", "}", relaxed)
+                try:
+                    return json.loads(relaxed)
+                except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                    parsed = ast.literal_eval(relaxed)
+                    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
+                        raise ValueError("configuration block is not a dict")
+                    return parsed
+
+    def _parse_response(self, response: str, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        try:
+            response = self._strip_code_fences(response)
+            raw_new_config = self._loads_config_block(self._extract_json_block(response))
+            allowed_keys = set(context.search_space.keys())
+            ignored_unknown = sorted(k for k in raw_new_config if k not in allowed_keys)
+            filtered = {k: v for k, v in raw_new_config.items() if k in allowed_keys}
+            # Keep the current valid settings for omitted keys; extra model-suggested
+            # fields should not force a fallback when the core decision is usable.
+            new_config = {k: v for k, v in context.current_config.items() if k in allowed_keys}
+            new_config.update(filtered)
+
+            config_start = response.find("NEW_CONFIG:")
+            brace_start = response.find("{")
+            reasoning_start = response.find("REASONING:")
+
+            if reasoning_start != -1:
+                reasoning_content_start = reasoning_start + len("REASONING:")
+                end_candidates = [
+                    pos
+                    for marker in ("NEW_CONFIG:", "CONFIDENCE:")
+                    if (pos := response.find(marker, reasoning_content_start)) != -1
+                ]
+                reasoning_end = min(end_candidates) if end_candidates else len(response)
+                reasoning = response[reasoning_content_start:reasoning_end].strip()
+            else:
+                reasoning_end = config_start if config_start != -1 else brace_start
+                if reasoning_end == -1:
+                    reasoning_end = len(response)
+                reasoning = response[:reasoning_end].strip()
+
+            reasoning = reasoning.replace("<think>", "").replace("</think>", "").strip()
+            if not reasoning:
+                reasoning = "Local model decision"
+
+            confidence = 0.7
+            match = re.search(r"CONFIDENCE:\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)", response)
+            if match:
+                confidence = float(match.group(1))
+            confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence))
+
+            is_valid, error_msg = self.validate_decision(new_config, context.search_space)
+            if not is_valid:
+                raise InvalidDecisionError(f"Invalid config: {error_msg}")
+
+            return AgentDecision(
+                new_config=new_config,
+                reasoning=reasoning,
+                confidence=confidence,
+                metadata={"raw_response": response, "raw_new_config": raw_new_config, "ignored_unknown_parameters": ignored_unknown},
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise InvalidDecisionError(f"Failed to parse local model response: {exc}") from exc
+
+    def _fallback_decision(
+        self,
+        context: DecisionContext,
+        error: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> AgentDecision:
+        metrics_history = context.metrics_history
+        new_config = context.current_config.copy()
+
+        if len(metrics_history) >= 2:
+            def metric_value(entry: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+                value = entry[1] if isinstance(entry, (list, tuple)) and len(entry) > 1 else entry
+                if isinstance(value, dict):
+                    value = value.get("accuracy")
+                try:
+                    return float(value)
+                except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                    return None
+
+            current_acc = metric_value(metrics_history[-1])
+            previous_acc = metric_value(metrics_history[-2])
+            if (
+                current_acc is not None
+                and previous_acc is not None
+                and current_acc <= previous_acc
+                and "learning_rate" in new_config
+            ):
+                new_config["learning_rate"] = max(new_config["learning_rate"] * 0.5, 1e-6)
+                return AgentDecision(
+                    new_config=new_config,
+                    reasoning="Fallback: plateau detected, halving learning rate.",
+                    confidence=0.55,
+                    metadata={"fallback": True, "error": error},
+                )
+
+        return AgentDecision(
+            new_config=new_config,
+            reasoning="Fallback: keeping current configuration.",
+            confidence=0.5,
+            metadata={"fallback": True, "error": error},
+        )
+
+    def _format_config(self, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+        return "\n".join(f"  {k}: {v}" for k, v in config.items())
+
+    def _format_search_space(self, search_space: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+        lines = []
+        for param, spec in search_space.items():
+            if isinstance(spec, list):
+                lines.append(f"- {param}: {spec}")
+            elif isinstance(spec, dict) and "min" in spec and "max" in spec:
+                scale = spec.get("scale", "linear")
+                lines.append(f"- {param}: [{spec['min']}, {spec['max']}] ({scale})")
+            else:
+                lines.append(f"- {param}: {spec}")
+        return "\n".join(lines)

+"""
+Base agent interface for AgentHPOBench framework.
+
+All agents must implement the Agent interface to participate in
+automatic repository reproduction tasks.
+"""
+
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DecisionContext:
+    """Context provided to agent for decision making."""
+
+    training_log: str  # Recent training logs (last N epochs)
+    current_config: Dict[str, Any]  # Current hyperparameter configuration
+    metrics_history: list  # Historical metrics [(epoch, metrics_dict), ...]
+    budget_remaining: int  # Remaining epochs
+    total_budget: int  # Total initial budget
+    search_space: Dict[str, Any]  # Valid hyperparameter ranges
+    epoch: int  # Current epoch number
+    decision_number: int  # Which decision this is (0-indexed)
+    metric_direction: Optional[str] = None  # higher/lower objective direction
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AgentDecision:
+    """Decision made by an agent."""
+
+    new_config: Dict[str, Any]  # New hyperparameter configuration
+    reasoning: str  # Explanation for the decision
+    confidence: float  # Confidence score [0, 1]
+    metadata: Dict[str, Any]  # Additional metadata
+
+
+class Agent(ABC):
+    """
+    Abstract base class for all agents in AgentHPOBench.
+
+    Agents analyze training logs and make hyperparameter adjustments
+    to optimize the declared target metric within a computational budget.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, name: str, model_name: str, **kwargs):
+        """
+        Initialize the agent.
+
+        Args:
+            name: Human-readable name for this agent
+            model_name: Model identifier (e.g., "gpt-4", "llama-3-70b")
+            **kwargs: Additional agent-specific parameters
+        """
+        self.name = name
+        self.model_name = model_name
+        self.config = kwargs
+
+        # Statistics
+        self.total_decisions = 0
+        self.invalid_decisions = 0
+        self.total_cost = 0.0  # API cost or compute time
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def decide(self, context: DecisionContext) -> AgentDecision:
+        """
+        Make a hyperparameter adjustment decision based on training context.
+
+        Args:
+            context: DecisionContext containing training logs, current config,
+                    metrics history, budget, and search space
+
+        Returns:
+            AgentDecision containing new hyperparameters, reasoning, and confidence
+
+        Raises:
+            InvalidDecisionError: If decision violates search space constraints
+        """
+        pass
+
+    def validate_decision(
+        self, decision: Dict[str, Any], search_space: Dict[str, Any]
+    ) -> tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
+        """
+        Validate that a decision is within the search space.
+
+        Args:
+            decision: Proposed hyperparameter configuration
+            search_space: Valid hyperparameter ranges
+
+        Returns:
+            (is_valid, error_message)
+        """
+        for param, value in decision.items():
+            if param not in search_space:
+                return False, f"Unknown parameter: {param}"
+
+            valid_range = search_space[param]
+
+            # Check if parameter is in valid range
+            if isinstance(valid_range, list):
+                if value not in valid_range:
+                    return False, f"{param}={value} not in valid range {valid_range}"
+            elif isinstance(valid_range, dict):
+                if "min" in valid_range and value < valid_range["min"]:
+                    return False, f"{param}={value} below minimum {valid_range['min']}"
+                if "max" in valid_range and value > valid_range["max"]:
+                    return False, f"{param}={value} above maximum {valid_range['max']}"
+
+        return True, None
+
+    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Return agent statistics."""
+        return {
+            "name": self.name,
+            "model_name": self.model_name,
+            "total_decisions": self.total_decisions,
+            "invalid_decisions": self.invalid_decisions,
+            "valid_decision_rate": (
+                (self.total_decisions - self.invalid_decisions) / self.total_decisions
+                if self.total_decisions > 0
+                else 1.0
+            ),
+            "total_cost": self.total_cost,
+        }
+
+    def reset_stats(self):
+        """Reset agent statistics."""
+        self.total_decisions = 0
+        self.invalid_decisions = 0
+        self.total_cost = 0.0
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"{self.__class__.__name__}(name='{self.name}', model='{self.model_name}')"
+
+
+class InvalidDecisionError(Exception):
+    """Raised when an agent makes an invalid decision."""
+
+    pass

+def _nonnegative_int(value: Any) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return 0
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return max(0, int(value))
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return max(0, int(float(value.strip())))
+        except ValueError:
+            return 0
+    return 0
+
+
+def _has_fallback_marker(value: Any) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return any(value.get(key) is True for key in FALLBACK_MARKERS) or any(
+            _has_fallback_marker(item) for item in value.values()
+        )
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return any(_has_fallback_marker(item) for item in value)
+    return False
+
+
+def _container_fallback_count(value: Any) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return sum(int(_has_fallback_marker(item)) for item in value)
+    return int(_has_fallback_marker(value))
+
+
+def fallback_count(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    """Return the strongest available fallback count for an experiment result."""
+    explicit = _nonnegative_int(payload.get("fallback_decision_count"))
+    nested = max(
+        (
+            _container_fallback_count(payload.get(container))
+            for container in DECISION_CONTAINERS
+        ),
+        default=0,
+    )

+def intervention_trace(

+    expected_length = expected_interventions + 1

+        explicit = [
+            item
+            for item in history
+            if isinstance(item, dict)
+            and (
+                item.get("kind") == "baseline"
+                or str(item.get("kind", "")).startswith("intervention_")
+            )
+        ]
+        if len(explicit) == expected_length:
+            return explicit, "explicit_history"
+        if len(history) == expected_length and all(
+            isinstance(item, dict) for item in history

+    for key in ("decisions_made", "agent_decisions_made", "strict_decision_count"):
+        value = payload.get(key)

+        if isinstance(value, str):

+def result_artifact_roots(

+        value = payload.get(key)
+        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+            continue
+        path = Path(value)
+        candidate = path if path.is_absolute() else task_dir / path
+        if candidate.exists():
+            roots.append(candidate)

+    if isinstance(run_id, str) and run_id.strip():
+        candidate = task_dir / "runs" / run_id

+                if isinstance(container.get(key), str) and container[key].strip()

+    raw_files = _artifact_files(roots, RAW_RESPONSE_PATTERNS)

+
+def _has_nonempty_value(value: Any) -> bool:

+        return False
+    if isinstance(value, str):

+
+

+        if normalized in aliases:

+    expected_variants = _model_identifier_variants(expected_model)
+    candidate_variants = _model_identifier_variants(candidate)
+    return any(

+        or expected in candidate
+        or candidate in expected
+        for expected in expected_variants

+        container = payload.get(container_name)
+        if isinstance(container, dict):
+            explicit_values.extend(
+                container.get(key) for key in MODEL_PROVENANCE_KEYS
+            )
+    explicit_values = [
+        value for value in explicit_values if _has_nonempty_value(value)
+    ]
+    if explicit_values:
+        return any(
+            _model_identifier_matches(expected_model, value)
+            for value in explicit_values
+        )
+
+    legacy_values = (
+        payload.get("run_id"),
+        payload.get("strict_serial_worker"),

+        _model_identifier_matches(expected_model, value)
+        for value in legacy_values
+        if _has_nonempty_value(value)

+
+def protocol_integrity_issues(
+    payload: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    expected_interventions: int = 5,
+    expected_seed: int | None = None,
+    require_seed: bool = True,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Validate the shared sequential protocol for one final result."""
+    issues: list[str] = []
+    trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    try:
+        trace, _ = intervention_trace(payload, expected_interventions)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        issues.append(str(exc))
+
+    decisions, _ = decision_count(payload, trace, expected_interventions)
+    if decisions != expected_interventions:
+        issues.append(
+            f"expected {expected_interventions} decisions, got {decisions}"
+        )
+
+    fallbacks = fallback_count(payload)
+    if fallbacks:
+        issues.append(f"fallback decisions: {fallbacks}")
+
+    for key in ("error", "task_error", "execution_error", "failure_reason"):
+        if _has_nonempty_value(payload.get(key)):
+            issues.append(f"nonempty task-level {key}")
+    for key in ("success", "agent_success"):
+        if key in payload and payload[key] is False:
+            issues.append(f"{key}=false")
+
+    replicate_seed = payload.get("replicate_seed")
+    if expected_seed is not None:
+        try:
+            recorded_seed = int(replicate_seed)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            if require_seed:
+                issues.append("missing or invalid replicate_seed")
+        else:
+            if recorded_seed != expected_seed:
+                issues.append(
+                    f"replicate seed mismatch: expected {expected_seed}, got {recorded_seed}"
+                )
+    return issues
+
+
+def local_model_integrity_issues(
+    result_path: Path,
+    payload: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    expected_interventions: int = 5,
+    expected_seed: int | None = None,
+    expected_model: str | None = None,
+    require_seed: bool = True,
+    require_raw_responses: bool = True,
+    check_artifacts: bool = True,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Validate the protocol and local-model provenance for one final result."""
+    issues = protocol_integrity_issues(
+        payload,
+        expected_interventions=expected_interventions,
+        expected_seed=expected_seed,
+        require_seed=require_seed,
+    )
+    if check_artifacts:
+        issues.extend(artifact_integrity_issues(result_path, payload))
+    if require_raw_responses:
+        nonempty_raw = raw_response_count(result_path, payload)
+        if nonempty_raw != expected_interventions:
+            issues.append(
+                f"expected {expected_interventions} nonempty raw responses, got {nonempty_raw}"
+            )
+
+    if expected_model and not model_provenance_matches(
+        result_path, payload, expected_model
+    ):
+        issues.append(f"configured model provenance not found: {expected_model}")
+    return issues

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Audit literal intervention spaces shared by agents and HPO baselines."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+METHOD_ROOTS = {
+    "agent": ROOT / "tasks/main",
+    "tpe": ROOT / "baselines/tpe",
+    "bohb": ROOT / "baselines/bohb",
+}
+EXPECTED_NONLITERAL_TASKS = {"agent_lightning_room_selector"}
+
+
+def task_ids() -> list[str]:
+    payload = json.loads((ROOT / "configs/tasks.json").read_text())
+    return [task["id"] for task in payload["tasks"]]
+
+
+def runner_path(method_root: Path, task_id: str) -> Path:
+    candidates = sorted((method_root / task_id).glob("run_formal*.py"))
+    if len(candidates) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Expected one Python runner for {task_id} under {method_root}, "
+            f"found {len(candidates)}"
+        )
+    return candidates[0]
+
+
+def literal_search_space(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(), filename=str(path))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if not isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
+            continue
+        targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
+        if not any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "SEARCH_SPACE" for target in targets):
+            continue
+        try:
+            value = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
+        except (ValueError, TypeError):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            return value
+    return None
+
+
+def audit() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    mismatches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    nonliteral: list[str] = []
+    comparable = 0
+
+    for task_id in task_ids():
+        spaces = {
+            method: literal_search_space(runner_path(root, task_id))
+            for method, root in METHOD_ROOTS.items()
+        }
+        if any(space is None for space in spaces.values()):
+            nonliteral.append(task_id)
+            continue
+        comparable += 1
+        reference = spaces["agent"]
+        differing = [method for method, space in spaces.items() if space != reference]
+        if differing:
+            mismatches.append(
+                {
+                    "task": task_id,
+                    "differing_methods": differing,
+                    "spaces": spaces,
+                }
+            )
+
+    unexpected_nonliteral = sorted(set(nonliteral) ^ EXPECTED_NONLITERAL_TASKS)
+    return {
+        "task_count": len(task_ids()),
+        "literal_space_task_count": comparable,
+        "nonliteral_tasks": sorted(nonliteral),
+        "mismatch_count": len(mismatches),
+        "mismatches": mismatches,
+        "unexpected_nonliteral_tasks": unexpected_nonliteral,
+        "passed": not mismatches and not unexpected_nonliteral,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    report = audit()
+    rendered = json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+    if args.output:
+        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        args.output.write_text(rendered + "\n")
+    print(rendered)
+    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compute task-bootstrap and paired-difference robustness summaries.
+
+The script consumes the strict final-step and best-so-far CSV exports. For
+three-seed methods, task values are averaged across seeds before task
+bootstrapping. Seed-level standard deviations are computed separately from
+the 30-task aggregate for each seed.
+
+The generated files map to the supplementary tables as follows:
+``final_step_bootstrap.csv`` supports Table 6,
+``best_so_far_bootstrap.csv`` and ``seed_level_summary.csv`` support Table 8,
+and ``paired_differences.csv`` supports Table 9.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import itertools
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+N_BOOTSTRAP = 20_000
+RNG_SEED = 20_260_731
+CATEGORY_ORDER = ["NLP", "CV", "TS", "Graph", "RL", "LLM", "SL"]
+
+METHOD_ORDER = [
+    "random_search",
+    "tpe",
+    "bohb",
+    "gemma2_2b",
+    "deepseek_r1_qwen_14b",
+    "qwen3_8b",
+    "llama3_1_8b",
+    "phi4_14b",
+    "qwen3_32b",
+    "glm5_1",
+    "kimi2_6",
+    "glm4_7",
+    "deepseek_v4_pro",
+    "gpt5_5",
+    "claude_sonnet_4_6",
+]
+
+DISPLAY_NAMES = {
+    "random_search": "Random search",
+    "tpe": "TPE",
+    "bohb": "BOHB variant",
+    "gemma2_2b": "Gemma2-2B",
+    "deepseek_r1_qwen_14b": "DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-14B",
+    "qwen3_8b": "Qwen3-8B",
+    "llama3_1_8b": "Llama-3.1-8B",
+    "phi4_14b": "Phi-4-14B",
+    "qwen3_32b": "Qwen3-32B",
+    "glm5_1": "GLM-5.1",
+    "kimi2_6": "Kimi-2.6",
+    "glm4_7": "GLM-4.7",
+    "deepseek_v4_pro": "DeepSeek-V4-Pro",
+    "gpt5_5": "GPT-5.5",
+    "claude_sonnet_4_6": "Claude Sonnet 4.6",
+}
+
+METHOD_TYPES = {
+    "random_search": "conventional_hpo",
+    "tpe": "conventional_hpo",
+    "bohb": "conventional_hpo",
+    "gemma2_2b": "open_weight",
+    "deepseek_r1_qwen_14b": "open_weight",
+    "qwen3_8b": "open_weight",
+    "llama3_1_8b": "open_weight",
+    "phi4_14b": "open_weight",
+    "qwen3_32b": "open_weight",
+    "glm5_1": "api",
+    "kimi2_6": "api",
+    "glm4_7": "api",
+    "deepseek_v4_pro": "api",
+    "gpt5_5": "api",
+    "claude_sonnet_4_6": "api",
+}
+
+METRIC_COLUMNS = {
+    "mbns": "bounded_normalized_score",
+    "maa_percent": "anchor_attainment",
+    "bwr_percent": "baseline_win",
+}
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def _read_inputs(root: Path) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
+    summary_dir = root / "results" / "summary"
+    controlled = pd.read_csv(summary_dir / "multiseed" / "multiseed_per_run.csv")
+    api = pd.read_csv(summary_dir / "multiseed" / "table1_api_per_run.csv")
+
+    controlled = controlled[
+        controlled["method"].isin(METHOD_ORDER)
+        & controlled["valid"].astype(str).str.lower().eq("true")
+    ].copy()
+    api = api[api["method"].isin(METHOD_ORDER)].copy()
+    api["seed"] = np.nan

+    # scoring summary. Reconstruct wins from BNS so tiny floating-point
+    # deviations from the shared baseline are not counted as improvements.
+    api["baseline_win"] = (
+        api["bounded_normalized_score"].astype(float) > 1e-8
+    ).astype(int)
+    final = pd.concat(
+        [
+            controlled[
+                [
+                    "method",
+                    "seed",
+                    "task",
+                    "category",
+                    "bounded_normalized_score",
+                    "baseline_win",
+                    "anchor_attainment",
+                ]
+            ],
+            api[
+                [
+                    "method",
+                    "seed",
+                    "task",
+                    "category",
+                    "bounded_normalized_score",
+                    "baseline_win",
+                    "anchor_attainment",
+                ]
+            ],
+        ],
+        ignore_index=True,
+    )
+
+    best = pd.read_csv(summary_dir / "best_so_far" / "best_so_far_detail.csv")
+    best = best[best["method"].isin(METHOD_ORDER)].copy()
+    category_map = (
+        final[["task", "category"]].drop_duplicates().set_index("task")["category"]
+    )
+    best["category"] = best["task"].map(category_map)
+    if best["category"].isna().any():
+        missing = sorted(best.loc[best["category"].isna(), "task"].unique())
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing categories for best-so-far tasks: {missing}")
+    return final, best
+
+
+def _validate_frame(frame: pd.DataFrame, label: str) -> None:
+    for method in METHOD_ORDER:
+        subset = frame[frame["method"].eq(method)]
+        expected_rows = 30 if METHOD_TYPES[method] == "api" else 90
+        if len(subset) != expected_rows:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{label}: {method} has {len(subset)} rows, expected {expected_rows}"
+            )
+        if subset["task"].nunique() != 30:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label}: {method} does not cover exactly 30 tasks")
+        if METHOD_TYPES[method] != "api":
+            seeds = sorted(int(seed) for seed in subset["seed"].unique())
+            if seeds != [0, 1, 42]:
+                raise ValueError(f"{label}: {method} has seeds {seeds}")
+        if subset[list(METRIC_COLUMNS.values())].isna().any().any():
+            raise ValueError(f"{label}: {method} contains missing metric values")
+
+
+def _task_categories(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
+    categories = frame[["task", "category"]].drop_duplicates()
+    if categories["task"].nunique() != 30 or len(categories) != 30:
+        raise ValueError("Task-to-category mapping is not one-to-one for 30 tasks")
+    counts = categories["category"].value_counts().to_dict()
+    expected = {"NLP": 3, "CV": 5, "TS": 7, "Graph": 2, "RL": 3, "LLM": 4, "SL": 6}
+    if counts != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected category counts: {counts}")
+    return categories.set_index("task")["category"]
+
+
+def _task_averages(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    return (
+        frame.groupby(["method", "task"], as_index=False)[list(METRIC_COLUMNS.values())]
+        .mean()
+        .sort_values(["method", "task"])
+    )
+
+
+def _seed_summary(frame: pd.DataFrame, estimand: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    controlled = frame[frame["method"].map(METHOD_TYPES).ne("api")].copy()
+    per_seed = (
+        controlled.groupby(["method", "seed"], as_index=False)[
+            list(METRIC_COLUMNS.values())
+        ]
+        .mean()
+        .rename(columns={value: metric for metric, value in METRIC_COLUMNS.items()})
+    )
+    per_seed["maa_percent"] *= 100
+    per_seed["bwr_percent"] *= 100
+
+    rows = []
+    for method in METHOD_ORDER:
+        if METHOD_TYPES[method] == "api":
+            continue
+        subset = per_seed[per_seed["method"].eq(method)]
+        row = {
+            "estimand": estimand,
+            "method": method,
+            "display_name": DISPLAY_NAMES[method],
+            "method_type": METHOD_TYPES[method],
+        }
+        for metric in METRIC_COLUMNS:
+            row[f"{metric}_mean"] = subset[metric].mean()
+            row[f"{metric}_sample_sd"] = subset[metric].std(ddof=1)
+        rows.append(row)
+    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
+
+
+def _draw_matrix(tasks: list[str], categories: pd.Series) -> np.ndarray:
+    task_to_index = {task: index for index, task in enumerate(tasks)}
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(RNG_SEED)
+    blocks = []
+    for category in CATEGORY_ORDER:
+        indices = np.array(
+            [task_to_index[task] for task in tasks if categories.loc[task] == category],
+            dtype=np.int64,
+        )
+        blocks.append(rng.choice(indices, size=(N_BOOTSTRAP, len(indices)), replace=True))
+    return np.concatenate(blocks, axis=1)
+
+
+def _bootstrap_summary(
+    task_average: pd.DataFrame,
+    tasks: list[str],
+    draws: np.ndarray,
+    estimand: str,
+) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, dict[str, np.ndarray]]]:
+    rows = []
+    distributions: dict[str, dict[str, np.ndarray]] = {}
+    for method in METHOD_ORDER:
+        indexed = task_average[task_average["method"].eq(method)].set_index("task")
+        indexed = indexed.loc[tasks]
+        method_distributions = {}
+        row = {
+            "estimand": estimand,
+            "method": method,
+            "display_name": DISPLAY_NAMES[method],
+            "method_type": METHOD_TYPES[method],
+        }
+        for metric, column in METRIC_COLUMNS.items():
+            scale = 100.0 if metric.endswith("_percent") else 1.0
+            values = indexed[column].to_numpy(dtype=float) * scale
+            bootstrap = values[draws].mean(axis=1)
+            method_distributions[metric] = bootstrap
+            row[f"{metric}_point"] = values.mean()
+            row[f"{metric}_ci_low"] = np.quantile(bootstrap, 0.025)
+            row[f"{metric}_ci_high"] = np.quantile(bootstrap, 0.975)
+        bns_values = indexed["bounded_normalized_score"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+        row["median_bns"] = np.median(bns_values)
+        rows.append(row)
+        distributions[method] = method_distributions
+    return pd.DataFrame(rows), distributions
+
+
+def _paired_differences(
+    summary: pd.DataFrame,
+    distributions: dict[str, dict[str, np.ndarray]],
+    estimand: str,
+) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    summary = summary.set_index("method")
+    rows = []
+    for method_a, method_b in itertools.combinations(METHOD_ORDER, 2):
+        for metric in METRIC_COLUMNS:
+            point = (
+                summary.loc[method_a, f"{metric}_point"]
+                - summary.loc[method_b, f"{metric}_point"]
+            )
+            difference = (
+                distributions[method_a][metric] - distributions[method_b][metric]
+            )
+            low = np.quantile(difference, 0.025)
+            high = np.quantile(difference, 0.975)
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "estimand": estimand,
+                    "metric": metric,
+                    "method_a": method_a,
+                    "display_name_a": DISPLAY_NAMES[method_a],
+                    "method_b": method_b,
+                    "display_name_b": DISPLAY_NAMES[method_b],
+                    "difference_a_minus_b": point,
+                    "ci_low": low,
+                    "ci_high": high,
+                    "excludes_zero": bool(low > 0 or high < 0),
+                }
+            )
+    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
+
+
+def _write_latex_rows(
+    output_dir: Path,
+    final_summary: pd.DataFrame,
+    best_summary: pd.DataFrame,
+    best_seed: pd.DataFrame,
+    pairwise: pd.DataFrame,

+    sections = []
+    final_index = final_summary.set_index("method")
+    best_index = best_summary.set_index("method")
+    seed_index = best_seed.set_index("method")

+    sections.append("% Final-step task-bootstrap rows")

+        row = final_index.loc[method]

+            f"\\({row.maa_percent_point:.1f}~[{row.maa_percent_ci_low:.1f},\\,{row.maa_percent_ci_high:.1f}]\\) & "
+            f"\\({row.median_bns:.3f}\\) & \\({row.bwr_percent_point:.1f}\\) \\\\"
+        )
+
+    sections.append("")
+    sections.append("% Best-so-far compact robustness rows")

+        row = best_index.loc[method]

+            sd = "--"
+        else:
