+        sections.append(
+            f"{DISPLAY_NAMES[method]} & \\({row.mbns_point:.3f}\\) & "
+            f"\\({sd}\\) & "
+            f"\\([{row.mbns_ci_low:.3f},\\,{row.mbns_ci_high:.3f}]\\) \\\\"
+        )
+
+    selected = [
+        ("final_step", "claude_sonnet_4_6", "gpt5_5"),
+        ("final_step", "phi4_14b", "qwen3_32b"),
+        ("final_step", "qwen3_32b", "bohb"),
+        ("best_so_far", "claude_sonnet_4_6", "gpt5_5"),
+        ("best_so_far", "gpt5_5", "random_search"),
+        ("best_so_far", "random_search", "phi4_14b"),
+        ("best_so_far", "random_search", "tpe"),
+        ("best_so_far", "random_search", "bohb"),
+        ("best_so_far", "phi4_14b", "qwen3_32b"),
+    ]
+    sections.append("")
+    sections.append("% Selected paired MBNS difference rows")
+    for estimand, method_a, method_b in selected:
+        match = pairwise[
+            pairwise["estimand"].eq(estimand)
+            & pairwise["metric"].eq("mbns")
+            & pairwise["method_a"].eq(method_a)
+            & pairwise["method_b"].eq(method_b)
+        ]
+        sign = 1
+        if match.empty:
+            match = pairwise[
+                pairwise["estimand"].eq(estimand)
+                & pairwise["metric"].eq("mbns")
+                & pairwise["method_a"].eq(method_b)
+                & pairwise["method_b"].eq(method_a)
+            ]
+            sign = -1
+        if len(match) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing selected comparison: {estimand} {method_a} {method_b}")
+        row = match.iloc[0]
+        point = sign * row["difference_a_minus_b"]
+        low = row["ci_low"] if sign == 1 else -row["ci_high"]
+        high = row["ci_high"] if sign == 1 else -row["ci_low"]
+        label = "Final step" if estimand == "final_step" else "Best so far"
+        sections.append(
+            f"{label} & {DISPLAY_NAMES[method_a]} -- {DISPLAY_NAMES[method_b]} & "
+            f"\\({point:.3f}~[{low:.3f},\\,{high:.3f}]\\) \\\\"
+        )
+
+    (output_dir / "latex_rows.tex").write_text("\n".join(sections) + "\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    args = parse_args()
+    root = args.root.resolve()
+    output_dir = (
+        args.output_dir.resolve()
+        if args.output_dir
+        else root / "results" / "summary" / "statistical_robustness"
+    )
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    final, best = _read_inputs(root)
+    _validate_frame(final, "final_step")
+    _validate_frame(best, "best_so_far")
+
+    categories = _task_categories(final)
+    tasks = sorted(categories.index.tolist())
+    draws = _draw_matrix(tasks, categories)
+
+    final_average = _task_averages(final)
+    best_average = _task_averages(best)
+    final_summary, final_distributions = _bootstrap_summary(
+        final_average, tasks, draws, "final_step"
+    )
+    best_summary, best_distributions = _bootstrap_summary(
+        best_average, tasks, draws, "best_so_far"
+    )
+    final_seed = _seed_summary(final, "final_step")
+    best_seed = _seed_summary(best, "best_so_far")
+    pairwise = pd.concat(
+        [
+            _paired_differences(final_summary, final_distributions, "final_step"),
+            _paired_differences(best_summary, best_distributions, "best_so_far"),
+        ],
+        ignore_index=True,
+    )
+
+    final_summary.to_csv(output_dir / "final_step_bootstrap.csv", index=False)
+    best_summary.to_csv(output_dir / "best_so_far_bootstrap.csv", index=False)
+    pd.concat([final_seed, best_seed], ignore_index=True).to_csv(
+        output_dir / "seed_level_summary.csv", index=False
+    )
+    pairwise.to_csv(output_dir / "paired_differences.csv", index=False)
+    _write_latex_rows(output_dir, final_summary, best_summary, best_seed, pairwise)
+
+    metadata = {
+        "bootstrap_resamples": N_BOOTSTRAP,
+        "rng_seed": RNG_SEED,
+        "bootstrap": "category-stratified paired task bootstrap",
+        "controlled_method_task_values": "mean across seeds 0, 1, and 42 before resampling",
+        "api_method_task_values": "single evaluation",
+        "best_so_far_candidates": "interventions 1 through 5; baseline excluded",
+        "supplement_table_mapping": {
+            "table_6": "final_step_bootstrap.csv",
+            "table_8": [
+                "best_so_far_bootstrap.csv",
+                "seed_level_summary.csv",
+            ],
+            "table_9": "paired_differences.csv",
+        },
+        "method_order": METHOD_ORDER,
+        "category_order": CATEGORY_ORDER,
+    }
+    (output_dir / "bootstrap_config.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n"
+    )
+
+    print(f"Wrote statistical robustness outputs to {output_dir}")
+    print(
+        final_summary[
+            ["display_name", "mbns_point", "mbns_ci_low", "mbns_ci_high"]
+        ].to_string(index=False)
+    )
+    print(
+        best_summary[
+            ["display_name", "mbns_point", "mbns_ci_low", "mbns_ci_high"]
+        ].to_string(index=False)
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import re
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+TASK_CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/tasks.json"
+DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG = ROOT / "configs/result_runs.example.json"
+DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = ROOT / "results/summary"
+TASK_ANCHOR_FALLBACKS = {
+    "forest_diffusion_iris_f1fake": 0.970038,
+}
+
+
+def parse_tasks():
+    payload = json.loads(TASK_CONFIG.read_text())
+    tasks = [
+        {
+            "index": item["index"],
+            "task": item["id"],
+            "repo": "",
+            "metric": "",
+        }
+        for item in payload["tasks"]
+    ]
+    if len(tasks) != 30:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"expected 30 tasks, got {len(tasks)}")
+    return tasks
+
+
+def parse_runs(path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, Path, str]]:
+    payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    runs = []
+    for item in payload["runs"]:
+        base = Path(item["path"])
+        if not base.is_absolute():
+            base = ROOT / base
+        runs.append((item["name"], base, item.get("type", "unknown")))
+    if not runs:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"run manifest contains no runs: {path}")
+    if len({name for name, _, _ in runs}) != len(runs):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"run names must be unique: {path}")
+    return runs
+
+
+def num(v):
+    if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(float(v)):
+        return float(v)
+    return None
+
+
+def nested(payload, paths):
+    for path in paths:
+        cur = payload
+        for key in path:
+            if isinstance(cur, dict) and key in cur:
+                cur = cur[key]
+            else:
+                cur = None
+                break
+        n = num(cur)
+        if n is not None:
+            return n
+    return None
+
+
+def infer_success(payload):
+    for key in ("success", "agent_success"):
+        if key in payload:
+            return bool(payload[key])
+    status = str(payload.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
+    if status in {"success", "succeeded", "done", "ok", "completed"}:
+        return True
+    if status in {"failed", "failure", "error", "timeout", "cancelled"}:
+        return False
+    if any(key in payload for key in ("error", "exception", "parse_error", "traceback")):
+        return False
+    result_markers = (
+        "normalized_score", "agent_final", "final", "final_metric", "best_metric",
+        "agent_budget_result", "final_agent_budget_result", "best_trial", "final_trial",
+        "best_metrics", "final_metrics", "metrics", "history",
+    )
+    return any(key in payload for key in result_markers)
+
+
+def infer_task_anchor(task, payload):
+    anchor = infer_paper_anchor(payload)
+    if anchor is not None:
+        return anchor

+            result[row["task"]] = {

+        attainment = value / anchor

+    raw_count = raw_response_count(result_path, payload)

+    parser.add_argument(

+    root = Path(args.root)
+    result_root = Path(args.result_root)
+    if not result_root.is_absolute():

+    slug = result_root.name
+
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    failed = False
+    for idx, task in enumerate(canonical_tasks(root), 1):
+        result_path, locate_error = locate_result(result_root / task, task)
+        row = {

+            "task": task,
+            "exists": result_path is not None,
+            "valid": False,
+            "trace_length": 0,
+            "raw_responses": 0,
+            "seconds": None,
+            "issues": [locate_error] if locate_error else [],
+            "result": str(result_path) if result_path else "",
+        }
+        if result_path is not None:

+                    expected_model=args.expected_model,

+                row["issues"] = issues
+                row["trace_length"] = trace_length
+                row["raw_responses"] = raw_count
+                row["valid"] = not issues

+                row["issues"] = [repr(exc)]
+        if not row["valid"]:

+    print("| # | task | result | valid | trace | raw | seconds | issues |")
+    print("|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|")
+    for row in rows:
+        result = "yes" if row["exists"] else "missing"
+        valid = "yes" if row["valid"] else "no"
+        seconds = "" if row["seconds"] is None else str(row["seconds"])
+        issues = "; ".join(row["issues"])
+        print(
+            f"| {row['idx']} | `{row['task']}` | {result} | {valid} | "
+            f"{row['trace_length']} | {row['raw_responses']} | {seconds} | {issues} |"
+        )
+    ok = sum(row["valid"] for row in rows)
+    print(
+        f"\nSummary: {ok}/{len(rows)} tasks passed exact trace, decision, "
+        "fallback, artifact, metric, and requested provenance checks."
+    )
+    return 0 if args.non_strict or not failed else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+TASK_CONFIG = ROOT / "configs" / "tasks.json"
+REPOSITORY_CONFIG = ROOT / "configs" / "repositories.json"
+OVERLAYS = (
+    ROOT / "tasks" / "main",
+    ROOT / "tasks" / "ablations" / "no_feedback",
+    ROOT / "baselines" / "tpe",
+    ROOT / "baselines" / "bohb",
+)
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> dict:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    task_items = load_json(TASK_CONFIG)["tasks"]
+    task_ids = [item["id"] for item in task_items]
+    repository_items = load_json(REPOSITORY_CONFIG)["repositories"]
+
+    if len(task_ids) != 30 or len(set(task_ids)) != 30:
+        errors.append(f"expected 30 unique tasks, found {len(task_ids)}")
+    if {item["task"] for item in repository_items} != set(task_ids):
+        errors.append("repository manifest does not match task manifest")
+
+    for overlay in OVERLAYS:
+        found = {
+            path.name
+            for path in overlay.iterdir()
+            if path.is_dir() and not path.name.startswith("__")
+        }
+        missing = sorted(set(task_ids) - found)
+        extra = sorted(found - set(task_ids) - {"seed_shim"})
+        if missing:
+            errors.append(f"{overlay.relative_to(ROOT)} missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
+        if extra:
+            errors.append(f"{overlay.relative_to(ROOT)} extra: {', '.join(extra)}")
+        for task_id in task_ids:
+            baseline = overlay / task_id / "baseline.json"
+            if not baseline.is_file():
+                errors.append(f"missing {baseline.relative_to(ROOT)}")
+                continue
+            try:
+                load_json(baseline)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                errors.append(f"invalid {baseline.relative_to(ROOT)}: {exc}")
+
+    print(f"tasks: {len(task_ids)}")
+    print(f"ray tasks: {sum(bool(item['ray']) for item in task_items)}")
+    print(f"overlays: {len(OVERLAYS)}")
+    if errors:
+        for error in errors:
+            print(f"ERROR: {error}")
+        return 1
+    print("task validation passed")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path, env: dict[str, str], log_path: Path, append: bool = False) -> float:
+    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    started = time.time()
+    mode = "ab" if append else "wb"
+    with log_path.open(mode) as log:
+        if append:
+            log.write(b"\n")
+        log.write(("COMMAND: " + " ".join(cmd) + "\n").encode())
+        log.flush()
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd), env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        tail = log_path.read_text(errors="replace")[-8000:]
+        print(tail, flush=True)

+    return round(time.time() - started, 3)

+def nearest(value: Any, choices: list[Any]) -> Any:
+    if not choices:
+        return value
+    if isinstance(choices[0], bool):
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+        return bool(value)
+    if isinstance(choices[0], str):
+        candidate = str(value).strip()
+        lower_map = {str(item).lower(): item for item in choices}
+        return lower_map.get(candidate.lower(), choices[0])
+    try:
+        number = float(value)
+        return min(choices, key=lambda item: abs(float(item) - number))
+    except Exception:
+        return choices[0]
+
+
+def clamp_config(
+    proposed: dict[str, Any],
+    base: dict[str, Any],
+    search_space: dict[str, list[Any]],
+    aliases: dict[str, str] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    aliases = aliases or {}
+    merged = dict(base)
+    for key, value in (proposed or {}).items():
+        mapped = aliases.get(str(key), str(key))
+        if mapped in merged:
+            merged[mapped] = value
+    clamped: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, value in merged.items():
+        if key in search_space:
+            selected = nearest(value, search_space[key])
+        else:
+            selected = value
+        if isinstance(base.get(key), int) and not isinstance(base.get(key), bool):
+            selected = int(selected)
+        elif isinstance(base.get(key), float):
+            selected = float(selected)
+        elif isinstance(base.get(key), bool):
+            selected = bool(selected)
+        clamped[key] = selected
+    return clamped
+

+            backend_name = "tpe_search"

+class HwfKB(KBBase):
+    def __init__(self, pseudo_label_list=SYMBOLS, max_err=1e-10):
+        super().__init__(pseudo_label_list, max_err)
+
+    def _valid_candidate(self, formula):
+        if len(formula) % 2 == 0:
+            return False
+        for i, token in enumerate(formula):
+            if i % 2 == 0 and token not in SYMBOLS[:9]:
+                return False
+            if i % 2 != 0 and token not in SYMBOLS[9:]:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def logic_forward(self, formula):
+        if not self._valid_candidate(formula):
+            return np.inf
+        return eval("".join(formula))
+
+
+class HwfGroundKB(GroundKB):
+    def __init__(self, pseudo_label_list=SYMBOLS, GKB_len_list=[1, 3, 5, 7], max_err=1e-10):

+
+    def _valid_candidate(self, formula):

+    def logic_forward(self, formula):

+

+            pass
+        return out
+    except Exception as exc:
+        fallback = fallback_config(decision_idx, current)
+        return {
+            "new_config": fallback,
+            "raw_new_config": fallback,
+            "reasoning": f"Agent decision failed; using deterministic ABLkit HWF fallback candidate. Error: {exc!r}",
+            "confidence": 0.0,
+            "metadata": {"fallback": True, "error": repr(exc)},
+        }
+
+
+def normalized_score(value: float, baseline: float) -> float:
+    denom = PAPER_ANCHOR_ACC - baseline
+    if abs(denom) < 1e-9:
+        return 0.0
+    return (value - baseline) / denom
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    decisions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    baseline_trial = run_eval("baseline", 0, BASE_CONFIG)
+    history.append(baseline_trial)
+    budget_baseline = metric_value(baseline_trial["metrics"])
+    current_config = dict(BASE_CONFIG)
+
+    for decision_idx in range(INTERVENTIONS):
+        decision = decide_with_qwen(history, current_config, budget_baseline, decision_idx)
+        next_config = clamp_config(decision["new_config"])
+        trial = run_eval("intervention", decision_idx + 1, next_config)
+        history.append(trial)
+        decisions.append(
+            {
+                "decision_number": decision_idx,
+                "old_config": current_config,
+                "new_config": next_config,
+                "raw_new_config": decision.get("raw_new_config"),
+                "reasoning": decision.get("reasoning"),
+                "confidence": decision.get("confidence"),
+                "metadata": decision.get("metadata"),
+                "trial_metric": metric_value(trial["metrics"]),
+            }
+        )
+        current_config = next_config
+
+    best_trial = max(history, key=lambda item: metric_value(item["metrics"]))
+    final_trial = history[-1]
+    best_acc = metric_value(best_trial["metrics"])
+    final_acc = metric_value(final_trial["metrics"])
+    summary = {
+        "agent": os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_LABEL", "QwenLocal"),
+        "benchmark_name": "ablkit_hwf_reasoning_accuracy",
+        "repo": "ABLkit",
+        "repo_url": "https://github.com/AbductiveLearning/ABLkit",
+        "task": "Handwritten formula abductive reasoning",
+        "model_path": str(AGENT_MODEL),
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "run_dir": str(OUT_DIR),
+        "paper_anchor": PAPER_ANCHOR_ACC,
+        "budget": {
+            **FIXED_BUDGET,
+            "metric": "reasoning_accuracy_percent",
+            "baseline_config": BASE_CONFIG,
+            "interventions": INTERVENTIONS,
+        },
+        "baseline_metrics": baseline_trial["metrics"],
+        "final_metrics": final_trial["metrics"],
+        "best_metrics": best_trial["metrics"],
+        "final_config": final_trial["config"],
+        "best_config": best_trial["config"],
+        "decisions": decisions,
+        "decisions_made": len(decisions),
+        "history": history,
+        "metric": "reasoning_accuracy_percent",
+        "higher_is_better": True,
+        "direction": "higher_is_better",
+        "agent_budget_result": best_acc,
+        "final_agent_budget_result": final_acc,
+        "official_budget_baseline": budget_baseline,
+        "paper_anchor_source": "ABLkit examples/hwf README: ABL HWF reasoning accuracy 99.2 for all formula lengths.",
+        "score": {
+            "normalized_score": normalized_score(best_acc, budget_baseline),
+            "delta_vs_budget_baseline": best_acc - budget_baseline,
+            "delta_vs_paper_anchor": best_acc - PAPER_ANCHOR_ACC,
+            "final_delta_vs_budget_baseline": final_acc - budget_baseline,
+            "final_delta_vs_paper_anchor": final_acc - PAPER_ANCHOR_ACC,
+            "official_budget_baseline": budget_baseline,
+            "paper_anchor": PAPER_ANCHOR_ACC,
+            "direction": "higher_is_better",
+        },
+        "success": True,
+    }
+    RESULT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    RESULT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+    (OUT_DIR / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+    print("FINAL_RESULT " + json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Formal Agent-Lightning room-selector prompt optimization benchmark.
+
+This keeps the original Agent-Lightning APO room-selector dataset and scoring
+split, but replaces closed API calls with a local Qwen3-32B evaluator. The agent
+chooses a prompt template on the train split and is scored on the validation
+split.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+_REPO_ROOT = Path(".")
+_deps_path = str(_REPO_ROOT / ".python_deps")
+while _deps_path in sys.path:
+    sys.path.remove(_deps_path)
+try:
+    import transformers.utils.import_utils as _tf_import_utils
+
+    _tf_import_utils.is_flash_attn_2_available = lambda: False
+    _tf_import_utils.is_flash_attn_greater_or_equal = lambda *args, **kwargs: False
+    _tf_import_utils.is_flash_attn_greater_or_equal_2_10 = lambda: False
+except Exception:
+    pass
+
+import torch
+from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
+
+
+ROOT = Path(".")
+TASK_PATH = ROOT / "repositories/agent-lightning/examples/apo/room_tasks.jsonl"
+OUT_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_RESULTS_BASE", str(Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_RESULTS_BASE", str(ROOT / "results/formal_agent/qwen3_32b")))))) / "agent_lightning_room_selector"
+MODEL_PATH = Path(os.environ.get("QWEN3_MODEL", "models/Qwen/Qwen3-32B"))
+
+OFFICIAL_BASELINE = 0.569
+PAPER_ANCHOR = 0.721
+ROOM_NAMES = ["Orion", "Lyra", "Vega", "Nova", "Quark", "Atlas", "Pulse"]
+
+
+ROOMS: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
+    {
+        "id": "Orion",
+        "capacity": 4,
+        "equipment": ["tv", "whiteboard"],
+        "accessible": True,
+        "distance_m": 12,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "10:00", 60], ["2025-10-13", "15:00", 30]],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Lyra",
+        "capacity": 10,
+        "equipment": ["projector", "whiteboard", "confphone"],
+        "accessible": True,
+        "distance_m": 30,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "09:30", 30], ["2025-10-13", "11:00", 60]],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Vega",
+        "capacity": 6,
+        "equipment": ["tv"],
+        "accessible": False,
+        "distance_m": 22,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "14:00", 60]],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Nova",
+        "capacity": 12,
+        "equipment": ["ledwall", "whiteboard", "confphone"],
+        "accessible": True,
+        "distance_m": 45,
+        "booked": [],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Quark",
+        "capacity": 8,
+        "equipment": ["projector", "whiteboard"],
+        "accessible": False,
+        "distance_m": 18,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "10:30", 30]],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Atlas",
+        "capacity": 6,
+        "equipment": ["projector", "whiteboard"],
+        "accessible": True,
+        "distance_m": 10,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "09:00", 30], ["2025-10-13", "13:30", 30]],
+    },
+    {
+        "id": "Pulse",
+        "capacity": 8,
+        "equipment": ["tv", "whiteboard", "confphone"],
+        "accessible": True,
+        "distance_m": 8,
+        "booked": [["2025-10-13", "16:30", 30]],
+    },
+]
+
+
+BASELINE_TEMPLATE = (
+    "Find a room on {date} at {time} for {duration_min} minutes, {attendees} attendees. "
+    "Needs: {needs}. Accessible required: {accessible_required}"
+)
+
+FALLBACK_TEMPLATES = [
+    BASELINE_TEMPLATE,
+    (
+        "You are selecting a meeting room. Use only the provided room JSON. Hard constraints: "
+        "free=true, capacity >= {attendees}, all needs {needs} are included, and accessible=true "
+        "when accessible_required is true. Tie-break in order: smallest capacity slack, fewest extra "
+        "equipment items, shortest distance_m, fewer booked blocks. Return No Room if none qualify. "
+        "Task: date={date}, time={time}, duration={duration_min}, attendees={attendees}, "
+        "accessible_required={accessible_required}."
+    ),
+    (
+        "Solve this as a constraint satisfaction problem. First filter unavailable rooms, then capacity, "
+        "equipment needs {needs}, and accessibility={accessible_required}. Choose the valid room with "
+        "minimum capacity slack, then minimum extra equipment, then minimum distance, then fewer bookings. "
+        "If the valid set is empty, answer No Room. Meeting: {date} {time}, {duration_min} min, "
+        "{attendees} attendees."
+    ),
+    (
+        "Given the meeting request and room-status JSON, output the exact best room id. Required output "
+        "format is final_choice: <Orion|Lyra|Vega|Nova|Quark|Atlas|Pulse|No Room>. Meeting request: "
+        "{attendees} people, needs={needs}, accessible_required={accessible_required}, start={date} "
+        "{time}, duration={duration_min} minutes. Apply all hard constraints before tie-breaking."
+    ),
+]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PromptCandidate:
+    name: str
+    template: str
+    source: str
+
+
+def tmin(t: str) -> int:
+    return int(t[:2]) * 60 + int(t[3:])
+
+
+def overlaps(start: str, dur: int, other_start: str, other_dur: int) -> bool:
+    a0, a1 = tmin(start), tmin(start) + dur
+    b0, b1 = tmin(other_start), tmin(other_start) + other_dur
+    return max(a0, b0) < min(a1, b1)
+
+
+def rooms_with_availability(task_input: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    status = []
+    for room in ROOMS:
+        free = all(
+            not (b_date == task_input["date"] and overlaps(task_input["time"], task_input["duration_min"], b_time, b_dur))
+            for b_date, b_time, b_dur in room["booked"]
+        )
+        status.append({**room, "free": free})
+    return status
+
+
+def load_tasks() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    with TASK_PATH.open() as f:
+        return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
+
+
+def normalize_choice(text: str | None) -> str:
+    if not text:
+        return ""
+    text = text.strip()
+    if re.search(r"\bNo\s+Room\b", text, re.IGNORECASE):
+        return "No Room"
+    for name in ROOM_NAMES:
+        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", text, re.IGNORECASE):
+            return name
+    return ""
+
+
+def extract_choice(generation: str) -> str:
+    match = re.search(r"final_choice\s*[:：]\s*([A-Za-z0-9 _-]+)", generation, re.IGNORECASE)
+    if match:
+        return normalize_choice(match.group(1))
+    tail = generation[-500:]
+    return normalize_choice(tail)
+
+
+def safe_format(template: str, task_input: dict[str, Any], rooms_json: str) -> str:
+    payload = {
+        **task_input,
+        "needs": ", ".join(task_input.get("needs", [])) or "none",
+        "rooms_json": rooms_json,
+    }
+    try:
+        return template.format(**payload)
+    except Exception:
+        return BASELINE_TEMPLATE.format(**payload)
+
+
+def build_eval_messages(task: dict[str, Any], template: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    task_input = task["task_input"]
+    rooms_json = json.dumps(rooms_with_availability(task_input), ensure_ascii=False)
+    user_prompt = safe_format(template, task_input, rooms_json)
+    return [
+        {
+            "role": "system",
+            "content": (
+                "You are a scheduling assistant. Select exactly one room from the room-status JSON, "
+                "or No Room. Obey hard constraints before tie-breaking. Return exactly two lines: "
+                "final_choice: <choice> and reason: <short reason>."
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": (
+                f"{user_prompt}\n\nRoom-status JSON:\n{rooms_json}\n\n"
+                "Hard constraints: room must be free, have capacity >= attendees, include all needed equipment, "
+                "and be accessible when requested. Tie-break valid rooms by smallest capacity slack, then fewest "
+                "extra equipment items, then shortest distance_m, then fewer booked blocks. "
+                "Return only final_choice and reason."
+            ),
+        },
+    ]
+
+
+def apply_chat_template(tokenizer: Any, messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str:
+    def render(candidate_messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str:
+        try:
+            return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+                candidate_messages,
+                tokenize=False,
+                add_generation_prompt=True,
+                enable_thinking=False,
+            )
+        except TypeError:
+            return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(candidate_messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
+
+    try:
+        return render(messages)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        if "System role not supported" not in str(exc):
+            raise
+        system_parts: list[str] = []
+        merged_messages: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+        for message in messages:
+            if message.get("role") == "system":
+                system_parts.append(message.get("content", ""))
+            else:
+                merged_messages.append(dict(message))
+        if system_parts:
+            system_text = "\n\n".join(part for part in system_parts if part)
+            if merged_messages and merged_messages[0].get("role") == "user":
+                merged_messages[0]["content"] = f"{system_text}\n\n{merged_messages[0].get('content', '')}"
+            else:
+                merged_messages.insert(0, {"role": "user", "content": system_text})
+        return render(merged_messages)
+
+
+def generate_texts(
+    model: Any,
+    tokenizer: Any,
+    messages_list: list[list[dict[str, str]]],
+    *,
+    max_new_tokens: int,
+    batch_size: int,
+) -> list[str]:
+    outputs: list[str] = []
+    for start in range(0, len(messages_list), batch_size):
+        batch_messages = messages_list[start : start + batch_size]
+        prompts = [apply_chat_template(tokenizer, messages) for messages in batch_messages]
+        encoded = tokenizer(prompts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=4096)
+        encoded = {k: v.to(model.device) for k, v in encoded.items()}
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            generated = model.generate(
+                **encoded,
+                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
+                do_sample=False,
+                temperature=None,
+                top_p=None,
+                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
+                eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
+            )
+        prompt_len = encoded["input_ids"].shape[1]
+        decoded = tokenizer.batch_decode(generated[:, prompt_len:], skip_special_tokens=True)
+        outputs.extend(decoded)
+    return outputs
+
+
+def extract_json_array(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    match = re.search(r"\[[\s\S]*\]", text)
+    if not match:
+        return []
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(match.group(0))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(data, list):
+        return [str(item) for item in data if isinstance(item, str) and "{date}" in item][:4]
+    return []
+
+
+def propose_candidates(model: Any, tokenizer: Any, train_tasks: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[PromptCandidate]:
+    examples = [
+        {
+            "request": t["task_input"],
+            "expected_choice": t["expected_choice"],
+        }
+        for t in train_tasks[:10]
+    ]
+    messages = [
+        {
+            "role": "system",
+            "content": "You optimize prompt templates for a room-selection agent. Return valid JSON only.",
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": (
+                "We need improve this baseline prompt template for a meeting-room selection task:\n"
+                f"{BASELINE_TEMPLATE}\n\n"
+                "Available placeholders: {date}, {time}, {duration_min}, {attendees}, {needs}, "
+                "{accessible_required}, {rooms_json}.\n"
+                "The agent receives room-status JSON separately and must output final_choice exactly.\n"
+                "Rules: filter by free, capacity, equipment, accessibility; tie-break by capacity slack, "
+                "extra equipment, distance, and number of booked blocks.\n"
+                f"Training examples:\n{json.dumps(examples, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"
+                "Return a JSON array of 3 concise prompt templates. Each template must include placeholders."
+            ),
+        },
+    ]
+    raw = generate_texts(model, tokenizer, [messages], max_new_tokens=int(os.environ.get("ROOM_SELECTOR_PROPOSE_TOKENS", "256")), batch_size=1)[0]
+    proposed = extract_json_array(raw)
+    candidates = [PromptCandidate("baseline", BASELINE_TEMPLATE, "repo_baseline")]
+    for idx, template in enumerate(proposed, 1):
+        candidates.append(PromptCandidate(f"qwen_proposed_{idx}", template, "qwen3_32b_agent"))
+    for idx, template in enumerate(FALLBACK_TEMPLATES[1:], 1):
+        candidates.append(PromptCandidate(f"fallback_{idx}", template, "manual_fallback"))
+
+    deduped: list[PromptCandidate] = []
+    seen = set()
+    for cand in candidates:
+        key = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cand.template.strip())
+        if key not in seen:
+            seen.add(key)
+            deduped.append(cand)
+    return deduped[: int(os.environ.get("ROOM_SELECTOR_MAX_CANDIDATES", "3"))]
+
+
+def evaluate_candidate(
+    model: Any,
+    tokenizer: Any,
+    candidate: PromptCandidate,
+    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    batch_size: int,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    messages = [build_eval_messages(task, candidate.template) for task in tasks]
+    generations = generate_texts(model, tokenizer, messages, max_new_tokens=96, batch_size=batch_size)
+    records = []
+    correct = 0
+    for task, generation in zip(tasks, generations):
+        prediction = extract_choice(generation)
+        expected = task["expected_choice"]
+        is_correct = normalize_choice(prediction) == normalize_choice(expected)
+        correct += int(is_correct)
+        records.append(
+            {
+                "id": task["id"],
+                "expected": expected,
+                "prediction": prediction,
+                "correct": is_correct,
+                "generation": generation,
+            }
+        )
+    return {
+        "name": candidate.name,
+        "source": candidate.source,
+        "template": candidate.template,
+        "accuracy": correct / len(tasks),
+        "correct": correct,
+        "total": len(tasks),
+        "records": records,
+    }
+
+
+def normalized_score(agent_value: float) -> float:
+    denom = PAPER_ANCHOR - OFFICIAL_BASELINE
+    if math.isclose(denom, 0.0):
+        return 0.0
+    return (agent_value - OFFICIAL_BASELINE) / denom
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    start_time = time.time()
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    tasks = load_tasks()
+    split = len(tasks) // 2
+    train_limit = int(os.environ.get("ROOM_SELECTOR_TRAIN_LIMIT", "16"))
+    val_limit = int(os.environ.get("ROOM_SELECTOR_VAL_LIMIT", "16"))
+    train_pool = tasks[:split]
+    val_pool = tasks[split:]
+    train_tasks = train_pool if train_limit <= 0 else train_pool[:train_limit]
+    val_tasks = val_pool if val_limit <= 0 else val_pool[:val_limit]
+    if not train_tasks or not val_tasks:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Agent-Lightning room-selector split is empty: train={len(train_tasks)} val={len(val_tasks)}")
+
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(MODEL_PATH), trust_remote_code=True)
+    if tokenizer.pad_token_id is None:

+
+    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
+        str(MODEL_PATH),

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+ARM_PROBS = torch.tensor([0.08, 0.16, 0.29, 0.48, 0.72, 0.91], dtype=torch.float32)
+OPTIMAL_ARM = int(torch.argmax(ARM_PROBS).item())
+
+
+def run_bandit(config: dict, steps: int, seed: int) -> dict:
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    logits = torch.zeros(len(ARM_PROBS), dtype=torch.float32, requires_grad=True)
+    opt_name = str(config.get("optimizer", "adam")).lower()
+    lr = float(config.get("learning_rate", 0.03))
+    if opt_name == "sgd":
+        optimizer = torch.optim.SGD([logits], lr=lr)
+    else:
+        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam([logits], lr=lr)
+
+    batch_size = int(config.get("batch_size", 32))
+    entropy_coef = float(config.get("entropy_coef", 0.01))
+    temperature = max(float(config.get("temperature", 1.0)), 1e-4)
+    baseline_mode = str(config.get("reward_baseline", "ema")).lower()
+    ema = 0.0
+    history = []
+
+    for step in range(int(steps)):
+        dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits / temperature)
+        actions = dist.sample((batch_size,))
+        probs = ARM_PROBS[actions]
+        rewards = torch.bernoulli(probs, generator=gen)
+        if baseline_mode == "mean":
+            baseline = rewards.mean()
+        elif baseline_mode == "ema":
+            batch_mean = float(rewards.mean().item())
+            ema = 0.9 * ema + 0.1 * batch_mean if step else batch_mean
+            baseline = torch.tensor(ema)
+        else:
+            baseline = torch.tensor(0.0)
+        advantage = rewards - baseline
+        log_prob = dist.log_prob(actions)
+        entropy = dist.entropy()
+        loss = -(advantage.detach() * log_prob).mean() - entropy_coef * entropy
+        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        loss.backward()
+        optimizer.step()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            policy = F.softmax(logits / temperature, dim=0)
+            history.append(
+                {
+                    "step": step + 1,
+                    "train_reward": float(rewards.mean().item()),
+                    "optimal_prob": float(policy[OPTIMAL_ARM].item()),
+                    "chosen_arm": int(torch.argmax(policy).item()),
+                    "loss": float(loss.detach().item()),
+                }
+            )
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        policy = F.softmax(logits / temperature, dim=0)
+        chosen_arm = int(torch.argmax(policy).item())
+        # Interpret success rate as the probability that a rollout selects the
+        # optimal arm, matching stochastic bandit evaluation rather than greedy
+        # argmax, which can saturate on tiny logit differences.
+        success_rate = float(policy[OPTIMAL_ARM].item())
+        expected_reward = float((policy * ARM_PROBS).sum().item())
+        optimal_prob = float(policy[OPTIMAL_ARM].item())
+
+    return {
+        "success_rate": success_rate,
+        "optimal_arm_probability": optimal_prob,
+        "expected_reward": expected_reward,
+        "chosen_arm": chosen_arm,
+        "optimal_arm": OPTIMAL_ARM,
+        "policy": [float(x) for x in policy.tolist()],
+        "history": history,
+        "config": config,
+        "steps": int(steps),
+        "seed": int(seed),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--results-dir", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=0.03)
+    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=32)
+    parser.add_argument("--entropy-coef", type=float, default=0.01)
+    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--reward-baseline", choices=["none", "mean", "ema"], default="ema")
+    parser.add_argument("--optimizer", choices=["adam", "sgd"], default="adam")
+    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=20)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    config = {
+        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
+        "batch_size": args.batch_size,
+        "entropy_coef": args.entropy_coef,
+        "temperature": args.temperature,
+        "reward_baseline": args.reward_baseline,
+        "optimizer": args.optimizer,
+    }
+    started = time.time()
+    result = run_bandit(config, args.steps, args.seed)
+    result["seconds"] = round(time.time() - started, 3)
+    out_dir = Path(args.results_dir)
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (out_dir / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    print("RESULT_JSON " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_ROOT", "."))
+FORMAL_DIR = ROOT / "baselines/bohb/align_anything_ragen_bandit"
+EVAL_SCRIPT = FORMAL_DIR / "eval_align_anything_ragen_bandit.py"
+AGENT_MODEL = Path(os.environ.get("QWEN3_MODEL", "models/Qwen/Qwen3-32B"))
+RESULT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_RESULTS_BASE", str(ROOT / "results/hpo/bohb"))) / "align_anything_ragen_bandit"
+RUN_ID = os.environ.get("RUN_ID") or f"align_anything_ragen_bandit_{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
+OUT_DIR = RESULT_ROOT / "runs" / RUN_ID
+RESULT_FILE = RESULT_ROOT / "align_anything_ragen_bandit_QwenLocal_results.json"
+
+PAPER_ANCHOR = 1.0
+BASE_CONFIG = {
+    "learning_rate": 0.01,
+    "batch_size": 16,
+    "entropy_coef": 0.0,
+    "temperature": 1.6,
+    "reward_baseline": "none",
+    "optimizer": "sgd",
+}
+SEARCH_SPACE = {
+    "learning_rate": {"choices": [0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3]},
+    "batch_size": {"choices": [16, 32, 64]},
+    "entropy_coef": {"choices": [0.0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.06]},
+    "temperature": {"choices": [0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.3, 1.6]},
+    "reward_baseline": {"choices": ["none", "mean", "ema"]},
+    "optimizer": {"choices": ["adam", "sgd"]},
+}
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def nearest(value: Any, choices: list[Any]) -> Any:
+    try:
+        numeric = float(value)
+        numeric_choices = [x for x in choices if isinstance(x, (int, float))]
+        if numeric_choices:
+            return min(numeric_choices, key=lambda item: abs(float(item) - numeric))
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    text = str(value).lower()
+    for item in choices:
+        if str(item).lower() == text:
+            return item
+    return choices[0]
+
+
+def clamp_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    aliases = {"lr": "learning_rate", "entropy": "entropy_coef", "baseline": "reward_baseline"}
+    merged = dict(BASE_CONFIG)
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        mapped = aliases.get(str(key), str(key))
+        if mapped in merged:
+            merged[mapped] = value
+    return {
+        "learning_rate": float(nearest(merged["learning_rate"], SEARCH_SPACE["learning_rate"]["choices"])),
+        "batch_size": int(nearest(merged["batch_size"], SEARCH_SPACE["batch_size"]["choices"])),
+        "entropy_coef": float(nearest(merged["entropy_coef"], SEARCH_SPACE["entropy_coef"]["choices"])),
+        "temperature": float(nearest(merged["temperature"], SEARCH_SPACE["temperature"]["choices"])),
+        "reward_baseline": str(nearest(merged["reward_baseline"], SEARCH_SPACE["reward_baseline"]["choices"])),
+        "optimizer": str(nearest(merged["optimizer"], SEARCH_SPACE["optimizer"]["choices"])),
+    }
+
+
+def slug(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    return (
+        f"lr{cfg['learning_rate']}_bs{cfg['batch_size']}_ent{cfg['entropy_coef']}"
+        f"_temp{cfg['temperature']}_{cfg['reward_baseline']}_{cfg['optimizer']}"
+    ).replace(".", "p")
+
+
+def run_eval(kind: str, trial_idx: int, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    trial_dir = OUT_DIR / kind / f"trial{trial_idx}_{slug(cfg)}"
+    metrics_path = trial_dir / "results.json"
+    if not metrics_path.exists():
+        trial_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        cmd = [
+            sys.executable,
+            str(EVAL_SCRIPT),
+            "--results-dir",
+            str(trial_dir),
+            "--learning-rate",
+            str(cfg["learning_rate"]),
+            "--batch-size",
+            str(cfg["batch_size"]),
+            "--entropy-coef",
+            str(cfg["entropy_coef"]),
+            "--temperature",
+            str(cfg["temperature"]),
+            "--reward-baseline",
+            cfg["reward_baseline"],
+            "--optimizer",
+            cfg["optimizer"],
+            "--steps",
+            str(int(os.environ.get("ALIGN_RAGEN_STEPS", "20"))),
+            "--seed",
+            "42",
+        ]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(ROOT), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        (trial_dir / "eval.log").write_bytes(proc.stdout)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            print(proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), flush=True)
+            raise RuntimeError(f"align-anything RAGEN bandit eval failed rc={proc.returncode}")
+    return {"trial": trial_idx, "kind": kind, "config": cfg, "metrics": load_json(metrics_path), "output_dir": str(trial_dir)}
+
+
+def training_log(history: list[dict[str, Any]], current: dict[str, Any], baseline: float) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        "Task: align-anything RAGEN Bandit policy optimization.",
+        "Metric: success_rate, 1.0 iff the learned policy selects the optimal arm after the budget. Higher is better.",
+        "Official anchor: align-anything technical report says the RAGEN Bandit task achieved 100% success rate within 200 training steps.",
+        "AgentHPOBench budget: 20 policy-gradient steps, i.e. 1/10 of the reported training-step budget.",
+        f"Budget baseline success_rate={baseline:.4f}, config={BASE_CONFIG}.",
+        f"Current config: {current}",
+    ]
+    for item in history:
+        m = item["metrics"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"Trial {item['trial']} {item['kind']}: config={item['config']} "
+            f"success_rate={m['success_rate']:.4f} optimal_prob={m['optimal_arm_probability']:.4f} "
+            f"expected_reward={m['expected_reward']:.4f}"
+        )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def extract_config(response: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], float, str]:
+    anchor = response.rfind("NEW_CONFIG:")
+    start = response.find("{", anchor if anchor >= 0 else 0)
+    if start < 0:
+        raise ValueError("missing config object")
+    depth = 0
+    end = -1
+    for idx, ch in enumerate(response[start:], start=start):
+        if ch == "{":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch == "}":
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                end = idx + 1
+                break
+    if end < 0:
+        raise ValueError("unterminated config object")
+    block = response[start:end]
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(block)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        parsed = ast.literal_eval(block)
+    confidence = 0.7
+    match = re.search(r"CONFIDENCE:\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)", response)
+    if match:
+        confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(match.group(1))))
+    return clamp_config(parsed), confidence, response
+
+
+def decide_with_qwen(history: list[dict[str, Any]], current: dict[str, Any], baseline: float, decision_number: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+
+    import os as _tpe_os
+    if _tpe_os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower() in {"tpe", "tpe_search", "bayesian", "bayesopt", "bayesian_optimization"}:
+        import sys as _tpe_sys
+        from pathlib import Path as _TpePath
+        _tpe_sys.path.insert(0, str(_TpePath(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+        from tpe_backend import tpe_decision_from_call
+        return tpe_decision_from_call(globals().get("TASK_ID", _TpePath(__file__).resolve().parent.name), locals(), globals())
+    backend = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower()
+    if backend in {"random", "random_search"}:
+        import random
+
+        seed = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_RANDOM_SEED", "0")
+        state = json.dumps({"history": history, "current": current, "decision_number": decision_number}, sort_keys=True, default=str)
+        rng = random.Random(f"{seed}:align_anything_ragen_bandit:{len(history)}:{state}")
+        raw = {key: rng.choice(list(spec["choices"])) for key, spec in SEARCH_SPACE.items()}
+        new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+        raw_response = json.dumps({
+            "backend": "random_search",
+            "seed": seed,
+            "raw_new_config": raw,
+            "new_config": new_config,
+        }, sort_keys=True)
+        return {"old_config": current, "new_config": new_config, "confidence": 0.0, "raw_response": raw_response}
+
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+    deps = ROOT / ".python_deps"
+    if deps.exists():
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(deps))
+    from agenthpobench.agents.open_source.qwen_agent import QwenAgent
+
+    prompt = f"""You are tuning an RL bandit policy-gradient experiment from align-anything/RAGEN.
+
+Target metric: maximize success_rate. Higher is better.
+
+Context:
+{training_log(history, current, baseline)}
+
+Search space:
+{json.dumps(SEARCH_SPACE, indent=2)}
+
+Return exactly these three lines. Use strict JSON with lowercase strings.
+REASONING: short explanation
+NEW_CONFIG: {{"learning_rate": 0.1, "batch_size": 64, "entropy_coef": 0.01, "temperature": 0.8, "reward_baseline": "ema", "optimizer": "adam"}}
+CONFIDENCE: 0.8
+"""
+    agent = QwenAgent(
+        model_path=str(AGENT_MODEL),
+        temperature=float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_TEMPERATURE", "0.0")),
+        max_new_tokens=int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS", "384")),
+        torch_dtype=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_TORCH_DTYPE", "bfloat16"),
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        device_map=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_DEVICE_MAP", "auto"),
+        use_chat_template=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE", "1").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"},
+    )
+    response = agent._generate(prompt)
+    (OUT_DIR / f"qwen_response_{decision_number}.txt").write_text(response)
+    try:
+        new_config, confidence, raw = extract_config(response)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        new_config = {"learning_rate": 0.1, "batch_size": 64, "entropy_coef": 0.01, "temperature": 0.8, "reward_baseline": "ema", "optimizer": "adam"}
+        confidence = 0.25
+        raw = f"fallback after parse error: {exc}\n{response}"
+    return {"old_config": current, "new_config": new_config, "confidence": confidence, "raw_response": raw}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    baseline = run_eval("baseline", 0, BASE_CONFIG)
+    baseline_score = float(baseline["metrics"]["success_rate"])
+    history = [baseline]
+    current = BASE_CONFIG
+    decisions = []

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import math
+import random
+import sys
+import time
+import types
+from copy import deepcopy
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+ART_UTILS = ROOT / "repositories/ART/examples/2048/utils.py"
+DIRECTIONS = ["left", "right", "up", "down"]
+MOVE_ORDERS = {
+    "left_up_right_down": ["left", "up", "right", "down"],
+    "up_left_right_down": ["up", "left", "right", "down"],
+    "right_up_left_down": ["right", "up", "left", "down"],
+    "down_left_right_up": ["down", "left", "right", "up"],
+}
+
+
+def load_art_utils() -> Any:
+    if "dotenv" not in sys.modules:
+        dotenv = types.ModuleType("dotenv")
+        dotenv.load_dotenv = lambda *args, **kwargs: False
+        sys.modules["dotenv"] = dotenv
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("art_2048_utils", ART_UTILS)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"failed to load ART 2048 utils from {ART_UTILS}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+U = load_art_utils()
+
+
+def board_tuple(game: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
+    return tuple(tuple(0 if cell is None else int(cell) for cell in row) for row in game["board"])
+
+
+def clone_game(game: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"id": game["id"], "board": deepcopy(game["board"])}
+
+
+def move_without_random(game: dict[str, Any], direction: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    nxt = clone_game(game)
+    before = board_tuple(nxt)
+    U.condense_board(nxt, U.Direction(direction))
+    after = board_tuple(nxt)
+    return None if after == before else nxt
+
+
+def count_empty(game: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    return sum(cell is None for row in game["board"] for cell in row)
+
+
+def max_tile(game: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    return max((cell or 0) for row in game["board"] for cell in row)
+
+
+def potential_merges(game: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
+    merges = 0
+    board = game["board"]
+    for r in range(4):
+        for c in range(4):
+            value = board[r][c]
+            if value is None:
+                continue
+            if c + 1 < 4 and board[r][c + 1] == value:
+                merges += 1
+            if r + 1 < 4 and board[r + 1][c] == value:
+                merges += 1
+    return merges
+
+
+def smoothness_penalty(game: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
+    penalty = 0.0
+    board = game["board"]
+    for r in range(4):
+        for c in range(4):
+            value = board[r][c]
+            if value is None:
+                continue
+            log_value = math.log2(value)
+            for rr, cc in ((r + 1, c), (r, c + 1)):
+                if rr < 4 and cc < 4 and board[rr][cc] is not None:
+                    penalty += abs(log_value - math.log2(board[rr][cc]))
+    return penalty
+
+
+def corner_score(game: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
+    weights = [
+        [16, 8, 4, 2],
+        [8, 4, 2, 1],
+        [4, 2, 1, 0.5],
+        [2, 1, 0.5, 0.25],
+    ]
+    score = 0.0
+    for r, row in enumerate(game["board"]):
+        for c, cell in enumerate(row):
+            if cell is not None:
+                score += math.log2(cell) * weights[r][c]
+    return score
+
+
+def heuristic(game: dict[str, Any], config: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
+    tile = max(max_tile(game), 2)
+    return (
+        float(config["empty_weight"]) * count_empty(game)
+        + float(config["merge_weight"]) * potential_merges(game)
+        + float(config["max_tile_weight"]) * math.log2(tile)
+        + float(config["corner_weight"]) * corner_score(game) / 32.0
+        - float(config["smoothness_weight"]) * smoothness_penalty(game)
+    )
+
+
+def search_value(game: dict[str, Any], config: dict[str, Any], depth: int) -> float:
+    if depth <= 0 or U.check_game_finished(game):
+        return heuristic(game, config)
+    best = -1e9
+    for direction in MOVE_ORDERS[str(config["move_order"])]:
+        nxt = move_without_random(game, direction)
+        if nxt is None:
+            continue
+        best = max(best, heuristic(nxt, config) + 0.75 * search_value(nxt, config, depth - 1))
+    return heuristic(game, config) if best == -1e9 else best
+
+
+def choose_move(game: dict[str, Any], config: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+    depth = int(config["lookahead_depth"])
+    best_move = None
+    best_score = -1e9
+    for direction in MOVE_ORDERS[str(config["move_order"])]:
+        nxt = move_without_random(game, direction)
+        if nxt is None:
+            continue
+        score = heuristic(nxt, config) + 0.75 * search_value(nxt, config, depth - 1)
+        if score > best_score:
+            best_score = score
+            best_move = direction
+    return best_move
+
+
+def play_game(config: dict[str, Any], seed: int, max_moves: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    random.seed(seed)
+    game = U.generate_game()
+    moves = 0
+    while moves < max_moves and not U.check_game_finished(game):
+        move = choose_move(game, config)
+        if move is None:
+            break
+        U.apply_agent_move(game, f"<move>{move}</move>")
+        moves += 1
+    maximum = max_tile(game)
+    return {
+        "win": maximum >= int(U.WINNING_VALUE),
+        "max_tile": maximum,
+        "total_board_value": U.total_board_value(game),
+        "moves": moves,
+        "board": board_tuple(game),
+    }
+
+
+def evaluate(config: dict[str, Any], games: int, max_moves: int, seed: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    game_results = [play_game(config, seed * 1000 + idx, max_moves) for idx in range(games)]
+    wins = sum(1 for item in game_results if item["win"])
+    return {
+        "win_rate": wins / float(games),
+        "wins": wins,
+        "games": games,
+        "max_moves": max_moves,
+        "avg_max_tile": sum(item["max_tile"] for item in game_results) / float(games),
+        "avg_total_board_value": sum(item["total_board_value"] for item in game_results) / float(games),
+        "avg_moves": sum(item["moves"] for item in game_results) / float(games),
+        "winning_value": int(U.WINNING_VALUE),
+        "config": config,
+        "seed": seed,
+        "game_results": game_results,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--results-dir", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--lookahead-depth", type=int, default=1)
+    parser.add_argument("--empty-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--merge-weight", type=float, default=0.5)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-tile-weight", type=float, default=1.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--corner-weight", type=float, default=0.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--smoothness-weight", type=float, default=0.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--move-order", choices=sorted(MOVE_ORDERS), default="left_up_right_down")
+    parser.add_argument("--games", type=int, default=25)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-moves", type=int, default=60)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config = {
+        "lookahead_depth": args.lookahead_depth,
+        "empty_weight": args.empty_weight,
+        "merge_weight": args.merge_weight,
+        "max_tile_weight": args.max_tile_weight,
+        "corner_weight": args.corner_weight,
+        "smoothness_weight": args.smoothness_weight,
+        "move_order": args.move_order,
+    }
+    started = time.time()
+    result = evaluate(config, args.games, args.max_moves, args.seed)
+    result["seconds"] = round(time.time() - started, 3)
+    out_dir = Path(args.results_dir)
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (out_dir / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+    print("RESULT_JSON " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_ROOT", "."))
+FORMAL_DIR = ROOT / "baselines/bohb/art_2048_win_rate"
+EVAL_SCRIPT = FORMAL_DIR / "eval_art_2048_win_rate.py"
+AGENT_MODEL = Path(os.environ.get("QWEN3_MODEL", "models/Qwen/Qwen3-32B"))
+RESULT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_RESULTS_BASE", str(ROOT / "results/hpo/bohb"))) / "art_2048_win_rate"
+RUN_ID = os.environ.get("RUN_ID") or f"art_2048_win_rate_{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
+OUT_DIR = RESULT_ROOT / "runs" / RUN_ID
+RESULT_FILE = RESULT_ROOT / "art_2048_win_rate_QwenLocal_results.json"
+
+PAPER_ANCHOR = 0.60
+BASE_CONFIG = {
+    "lookahead_depth": 2,
+    "empty_weight": 2.0,
+    "merge_weight": 1.0,
+    "max_tile_weight": 2.0,
+    "corner_weight": 2.0,
+    "smoothness_weight": 0.2,
+    "move_order": "up_left_right_down",
+}
+SEARCH_SPACE = {
+    "lookahead_depth": {"choices": [1, 2, 3]},
+    "empty_weight": {"choices": [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0]},
+    "merge_weight": {"choices": [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0]},
+    "max_tile_weight": {"choices": [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0]},
+    "corner_weight": {"choices": [0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0]},
+    "smoothness_weight": {"choices": [0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0]},
+    "move_order": {"choices": ["left_up_right_down", "up_left_right_down", "right_up_left_down", "down_left_right_up"]},
+}
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def nearest(value: Any, choices: list[Any]) -> Any:
+    try:
+        numeric = float(value)
+        numeric_choices = [x for x in choices if isinstance(x, (int, float))]
+        if numeric_choices:
+            return min(numeric_choices, key=lambda item: abs(float(item) - numeric))
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    text = str(value).lower()
+    for item in choices:
+        if str(item).lower() == text:
+            return item
+    return choices[0]
+
+
+def clamp_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    aliases = {"depth": "lookahead_depth", "smoothness": "smoothness_weight", "corner": "corner_weight"}
+    merged = dict(BASE_CONFIG)
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        mapped = aliases.get(str(key), str(key))
+        if mapped in merged:
+            merged[mapped] = value
+    return {
+        "lookahead_depth": int(nearest(merged["lookahead_depth"], SEARCH_SPACE["lookahead_depth"]["choices"])),
+        "empty_weight": float(nearest(merged["empty_weight"], SEARCH_SPACE["empty_weight"]["choices"])),
+        "merge_weight": float(nearest(merged["merge_weight"], SEARCH_SPACE["merge_weight"]["choices"])),
+        "max_tile_weight": float(nearest(merged["max_tile_weight"], SEARCH_SPACE["max_tile_weight"]["choices"])),
+        "corner_weight": float(nearest(merged["corner_weight"], SEARCH_SPACE["corner_weight"]["choices"])),
+        "smoothness_weight": float(nearest(merged["smoothness_weight"], SEARCH_SPACE["smoothness_weight"]["choices"])),
+        "move_order": str(nearest(merged["move_order"], SEARCH_SPACE["move_order"]["choices"])),
+    }
+
+
+def slug(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    return (
+        f"d{cfg['lookahead_depth']}_empty{cfg['empty_weight']}_merge{cfg['merge_weight']}"
+        f"_max{cfg['max_tile_weight']}_corner{cfg['corner_weight']}_smooth{cfg['smoothness_weight']}_{cfg['move_order']}"
+    ).replace(".", "p")
+
+
+def run_eval(kind: str, trial_idx: int, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    trial_dir = OUT_DIR / kind / f"trial{trial_idx}_{slug(cfg)}"
+    metrics_path = trial_dir / "results.json"
+    if not metrics_path.exists():
+        trial_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        cmd = [
+            sys.executable,
+            str(EVAL_SCRIPT),
+            "--results-dir",
+            str(trial_dir),
+            "--lookahead-depth",
+            str(cfg["lookahead_depth"]),
+            "--empty-weight",
+            str(cfg["empty_weight"]),
+            "--merge-weight",
+            str(cfg["merge_weight"]),
+            "--max-tile-weight",
+            str(cfg["max_tile_weight"]),
+            "--corner-weight",
+            str(cfg["corner_weight"]),
+            "--smoothness-weight",
+            str(cfg["smoothness_weight"]),
+            "--move-order",
+            cfg["move_order"],
+            "--games",
+            str(int(os.environ.get("ART_2048_GAMES", "25"))),
+            "--max-moves",
+            str(int(os.environ.get("ART_2048_MAX_MOVES", "70"))),
+            "--seed",
+            "42",
+        ]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(ROOT), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        (trial_dir / "eval.log").write_bytes(proc.stdout)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            print(proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), flush=True)
+            raise RuntimeError(f"ART 2048 eval failed rc={proc.returncode}")
+    return {"trial": trial_idx, "kind": kind, "config": cfg, "metrics": load_json(metrics_path), "output_dir": str(trial_dir)}
+
+
+def training_log(history: list[dict[str, Any]], current: dict[str, Any], baseline: float) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        "Task: ART 2048 game policy benchmark.",
+        "Metric: win_rate over fixed-seed games. Higher is better. A win means the game reaches the repo's WINNING_VALUE=128.",
+        "Official anchor: ART assets/benchmarks/2048/accuracy-comparison.svg reports the RL agent at 60% games won.",
+        "AgentHPOBench budget: 25 fixed-seed games, max 70 moves per game.",
+        f"Budget baseline win_rate={baseline:.4f}, config={BASE_CONFIG}.",
+        f"Current config: {current}",
+    ]
+    for item in history:
+        m = item["metrics"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"Trial {item['trial']} {item['kind']}: config={item['config']} "
+            f"win_rate={m['win_rate']:.4f} avg_max_tile={m['avg_max_tile']:.2f} avg_moves={m['avg_moves']:.2f}"
+        )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def extract_config(response: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], float, str]:
+    anchor = response.rfind("NEW_CONFIG:")
+    start = response.find("{", anchor if anchor >= 0 else 0)
+    if start < 0:
+        raise ValueError("missing config object")
+    depth = 0
+    end = -1
+    for idx, ch in enumerate(response[start:], start=start):
+        if ch == "{":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch == "}":
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                end = idx + 1
+                break
+    if end < 0:
+        raise ValueError("unterminated config object")
+    block = response[start:end]
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(block)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        parsed = ast.literal_eval(block)
+    confidence = 0.7
+    match = re.search(r"CONFIDENCE:\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)", response)
+    if match:
+        confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(match.group(1))))
+    return clamp_config(parsed), confidence, response
+
+
+def decide_with_qwen(history: list[dict[str, Any]], current: dict[str, Any], baseline: float, decision_number: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+
+    import os as _tpe_os
+    if _tpe_os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower() in {"tpe", "tpe_search", "bayesian", "bayesopt", "bayesian_optimization"}:
+        import sys as _tpe_sys
+        from pathlib import Path as _TpePath
+        _tpe_sys.path.insert(0, str(_TpePath(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+        from tpe_backend import tpe_decision_from_call
+        return tpe_decision_from_call(globals().get("TASK_ID", _TpePath(__file__).resolve().parent.name), locals(), globals())
+    backend = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower()
+    if backend in {"random", "random_search"}:
+        import random
+
+        seed = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_RANDOM_SEED", "0")
+        state = json.dumps(history, sort_keys=True, default=str)
+        rng = random.Random(f"{seed}:art_2048_win_rate:{decision_number}:{state}")
+        raw = {key: rng.choice(list(spec["choices"])) for key, spec in SEARCH_SPACE.items()}
+        new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+        return {
+            "old_config": current,
+            "new_config": new_config,
+            "confidence": 0.0,
+            "raw_response": "Uniform random sample from the constrained ART search space.",
+            "metadata": {"backend": "random_search", "seed": seed, "search_space_keys": sorted(SEARCH_SPACE)},
+        }
+
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+    deps = ROOT / ".python_deps"
+    if deps.exists():
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(deps))
+    from agenthpobench.agents.open_source.qwen_agent import QwenAgent
+
+    prompt = f"""You are tuning a heuristic policy for the ART 2048 benchmark.
+
+Target metric: maximize win_rate. Higher is better.
+
+Context:
+{training_log(history, current, baseline)}
+
+Search space:
+{json.dumps(SEARCH_SPACE, indent=2)}
+
+Return exactly these three lines. Use strict JSON with lowercase strings.
+REASONING: short explanation
+NEW_CONFIG: {{"lookahead_depth": 1, "empty_weight": 1.0, "merge_weight": 0.5, "max_tile_weight": 1.0, "corner_weight": 0.0, "smoothness_weight": 0.0, "move_order": "left_up_right_down"}}
+CONFIDENCE: 0.8
+"""
+    agent = QwenAgent(
+        model_path=str(AGENT_MODEL),
+        temperature=float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_TEMPERATURE", "0.0")),
+        max_new_tokens=int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS", "384")),
+        torch_dtype=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_TORCH_DTYPE", "bfloat16"),
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        device_map=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_DEVICE_MAP", "auto"),
+        use_chat_template=os.environ.get("AUTOREP_USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE", "1").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"},
+    )
+    response = agent._generate(prompt)
+    (OUT_DIR / f"qwen_response_{decision_number}.txt").write_text(response)
+    try:
+        new_config, confidence, raw = extract_config(response)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        new_config = {
+            "lookahead_depth": 1,
+            "empty_weight": 1.0,
+            "merge_weight": 0.5,
+            "max_tile_weight": 1.0,
+            "corner_weight": 0.0,
+            "smoothness_weight": 0.0,
+            "move_order": "left_up_right_down",
+        }
+        confidence = 0.25
+        raw = f"fallback after parse error: {exc}\n{response}"
+    return {"old_config": current, "new_config": new_config, "confidence": confidence, "raw_response": raw}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    baseline = run_eval("baseline", 0, BASE_CONFIG)
+    baseline_score = float(baseline["metrics"]["win_rate"])
+    history = [baseline]
+    current = BASE_CONFIG
+    decisions = []

+        current = decision["new_config"]
+        history.append(run_eval(f"intervention_{i+1}", i + 1, current))

+        "official_budget_baseline": baseline_score,
+        "baseline_metrics": baseline["metrics"],
+        "final_metrics": final["metrics"],
+        "best_metrics": best["metrics"],

+    print("RESULT_JSON " + json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import pandas as pd
+from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
+from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, RandomForestClassifier
+from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
+from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
+from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
+from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
+from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
+from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
+
+
+ROOT = Path(".")
+DATA_DIR = ROOT / "data/paper_exact/binary_diffusion_adult_rf"
+
+
+def parse_none(value: str | None) -> Any:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if str(value).lower() in {"none", "null"}:
+        return None
+    return value
+
+
+def build_model(args: argparse.Namespace):
+    class_weight = parse_none(args.class_weight)
+    family = args.model_family.lower()
+    if family == "rf":
+        return RandomForestClassifier(
+            n_estimators=args.n_estimators,
+            max_depth=args.max_depth,
+            min_samples_leaf=args.min_samples_leaf,
+            criterion=args.criterion,
+            max_features=parse_none(args.max_features),
+            class_weight=class_weight,
+            random_state=args.seed,
+            n_jobs=1,
+        )
+    if family == "extra_trees":
+        return ExtraTreesClassifier(
+            n_estimators=args.n_estimators,
+            max_depth=args.max_depth,
+            min_samples_leaf=args.min_samples_leaf,
+            criterion=args.criterion,
+            max_features=parse_none(args.max_features),
+            class_weight=class_weight,
+            random_state=args.seed,
+            n_jobs=1,
+        )
+    if family == "tree":
+        return DecisionTreeClassifier(
+            max_depth=args.max_depth,
+            min_samples_leaf=args.min_samples_leaf,
+            criterion=args.criterion,
+            class_weight=class_weight,
+            random_state=args.seed,
+        )
+    if family == "gb":
+        return GradientBoostingClassifier(
+            n_estimators=args.n_estimators,
+            learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
+            max_depth=3 if args.max_depth is None else min(args.max_depth, 4),
+            min_samples_leaf=args.min_samples_leaf,
+            random_state=args.seed,
+        )
+    if family == "lr":
+        return LogisticRegression(C=args.C, class_weight=class_weight, random_state=args.seed, max_iter=1000)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported model_family={args.model_family!r}")
+
+
+def encode_target(series: pd.Series, positive_label: str | None) -> pd.Series:
+    if positive_label is not None:
+        return (series.astype(str) == str(positive_label)).astype(int)
+    values = list(pd.Series(series).dropna().unique())
+    if len(values) != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected a binary target, got {len(values)} labels: {values[:10]}")
+    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
+        return (series == max(values)).astype(int)
+    positive = sorted(map(str, values))[-1]
+    return (series.astype(str) == positive).astype(int)
+
+
+def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    started = time.time()
+    train = pd.read_csv(args.train_file)
+    test = pd.read_csv(args.test_file)
+    target = args.target_column
+    X_train = train.drop(columns=[target])
+    y_train = encode_target(train[target], args.positive_label)
+    X_test = test.drop(columns=[target])
+    y_test = encode_target(test[target], args.positive_label)
+
+    numerical = [c for c in X_train.columns if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X_train[c])]
+    categorical = [c for c in X_train.columns if c not in numerical]
+    transformers = []
+    if numerical:
+        transformers.append(("num", Pipeline([("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("scale", StandardScaler())]), numerical))
+    if categorical:
+        transformers.append(("cat", Pipeline([("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")), ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"))]), categorical))
+    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers)
+    pipeline = Pipeline([("preprocess", preprocessor), ("model", build_model(args))])
+    pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)
+    train_pred = pipeline.predict(X_train)
+    test_pred = pipeline.predict(X_test)
+    train_accuracy = float(accuracy_score(y_train, train_pred))
+    test_accuracy = float(accuracy_score(y_test, test_pred))
+    result = {
+        "task": "binary_diffusion_adult_rf",
+        "repo": "binary-diffusion-tabular",
+        "dataset": "Adult Income",
+        "train_file": str(args.train_file),
+        "test_file": str(args.test_file),
+        "target_column": target,
+        "metric": "accuracy",
+        "model_family": args.model_family,
+        "n_estimators": args.n_estimators,
+        "max_depth": args.max_depth,
+        "min_samples_leaf": args.min_samples_leaf,
+        "criterion": args.criterion,
+        "max_features": parse_none(args.max_features),
+        "class_weight": parse_none(args.class_weight),
+        "learning_rate": args.learning_rate,
+        "C": args.C,
+        "seed": args.seed,
+        "train_accuracy": train_accuracy,
+        "test_accuracy": test_accuracy,
+        "train_accuracy_percent": train_accuracy * 100.0,
+        "test_accuracy_percent": test_accuracy * 100.0,
+        "seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
+    }
+    args.results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (args.results_dir / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--results-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--train-file", type=Path, default=DATA_DIR / "adult_train.csv")
+    parser.add_argument("--test-file", type=Path, default=DATA_DIR / "adult_test.csv")
+    parser.add_argument("--target-column", default="label")
+    parser.add_argument("--positive-label", default='>50K')
+    parser.add_argument("--model-family", choices=["rf", "extra_trees", "tree", "gb", "lr"], default="rf")
+    parser.add_argument("--n-estimators", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-depth", type=lambda value: None if value.lower() == "none" else int(value), default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--min-samples-leaf", type=int, default=1)
+    parser.add_argument("--criterion", choices=["gini", "entropy", "log_loss"], default="gini")
+    parser.add_argument("--max-features", choices=["sqrt", "log2", "none"], default="sqrt")
+    parser.add_argument("--class-weight", choices=["none", "balanced"], default="none")
+    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=0.1)
+    parser.add_argument("--C", type=float, default=1.0)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    run(args)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
