+def nearest(value: Any, choices: list[Any]) -> Any:
+    try:
+        numeric = float(value)
+        return min(choices, key=lambda item: abs(float(item) - numeric))
+    except Exception:
+        text = str(value).lower().strip()
+        for item in choices:
+            if str(item).lower() == text:
+                return item
+        return choices[0]
+
+
+def clamp_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    aliases = {
+        "lr": "learning_rate",
+        "learning_rate": "learning_rate",
+        "width": "d_model",
+        "hidden_size": "d_model",
+        "ffn_dim": "d_ff",
+        "layers": "e_layers",
+        "num_layers": "e_layers",
+        "patch": "patch_len",
+        "batch": "batch_size",
+    }
+    merged = dict(BASE_CONFIG)
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        mapped = aliases.get(str(key), str(key))
+        if mapped in merged:
+            merged[mapped] = value
+    return {
+        "d_model": int(nearest(merged["d_model"], SEARCH_SPACE["d_model"]["choices"])),
+        "d_ff": int(nearest(merged["d_ff"], SEARCH_SPACE["d_ff"]["choices"])),
+        "e_layers": int(nearest(merged["e_layers"], SEARCH_SPACE["e_layers"]["choices"])),
+        "patch_len": int(nearest(merged["patch_len"], SEARCH_SPACE["patch_len"]["choices"])),
+        "learning_rate": float(nearest(merged["learning_rate"], SEARCH_SPACE["learning_rate"]["choices"])),
+        "batch_size": int(nearest(merged["batch_size"], SEARCH_SPACE["batch_size"]["choices"])),
+    }
+
+
+def slug(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    return (
+        f"dm{cfg['d_model']}_df{cfg['d_ff']}_l{cfg['e_layers']}_patch{cfg['patch_len']}"
+        f"_lr{cfg['learning_rate']}_bs{cfg['batch_size']}"
+    ).replace(".", "p")
+
+
+def run_eval(kind: str, trial_idx: int, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = clamp_config(config)
+    trial_dir = OUT_DIR / kind / f"trial{trial_idx}_{slug(cfg)}"
+    metrics_path = trial_dir / "results.json"
+    if not metrics_path.exists():
+        trial_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        env = os.environ.copy()
+        env["TIMEXER_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = os.environ.get("TIMEXER_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "1")
+        env["PYTHONPATH"] = f"{ROOT / 'repositories/TimeXer'}:{ROOT / '.python_deps'}"
+        cmd = [
+            "bash",
+            "-lc",
+            "source ${CONDA_ROOT:-/opt/miniconda3}/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && "
+            "conda activate autorep-vlm2vec && "
+            f"python {EVAL_SCRIPT} "
+            f"--results-dir {trial_dir} "
+            f"--run-name {kind}{trial_idx} "
+            f"--d-model {cfg['d_model']} "
+            f"--d-ff {cfg['d_ff']} "
+            f"--e-layers {cfg['e_layers']} "
+            f"--patch-len {cfg['patch_len']} "
+            f"--learning-rate {cfg['learning_rate']} "
+            f"--batch-size {cfg['batch_size']} "
+            f"--epochs {FIXED['epochs']} "
+            "--patience 1",
+        ]
+        started = time.time()
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(ROOT), env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        text = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        (trial_dir / "outer.log").write_text(text)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            print(text, flush=True)
+            raise RuntimeError(f"TimeXer eval failed rc={proc.returncode}")
+        payload = load_json(metrics_path)
+        payload["seconds_outer"] = round(time.time() - started, 3)
+        metrics_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
+    payload = load_json(metrics_path)
+    return {"trial": trial_idx, "kind": kind, "config": cfg, "metrics": payload, "output_dir": str(trial_dir)}
+
+
+def parse_config(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    for pattern in [
+        r"NEW_CONFIG\s*[:=]\s*(\{.*?\})",
+        r"```json\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```",
+        r"(\{[^{}]*(?:d_model|learning_rate|batch_size|patch_len)[^{}]*\})",
+    ]:
+        match = re.search(pattern, text, flags=re.S | re.I)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        payload = match.group(1)
+        try:
+            return json.loads(payload)
+        except Exception:
+            try:
+                return ast.literal_eval(payload)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+    raise ValueError("no JSON config found")
+
+
+def training_log(history: list[dict[str, Any]], baseline: float) -> str:
+    lines = [
+        "Task: TimeXer NeurIPS 2024, EPF/PJM electricity price forecasting with exogenous variables.",
+        "Metric: test_mse, lower is better. Paper/README anchor for PJM: MSE=0.093, MAE=0.192.",
+        "Budget: fixed 1 train epoch, official TimeXer custom split, seq_len=168, pred_len=24, features=MS.",
+        "Short-budget prior: with 1 epoch, batch_size=128 at d_model=64,d_ff=64,e_layers=1,patch_len=24,lr=0.0005 reached test_mse about 0.1266; lr=0.001 was worse; d_model=128/e_layers=2 was not helpful in a 2-epoch probe.",
+        f"Budget baseline test_mse={baseline:.6f}, config={BASE_CONFIG}.",
+    ]
+    for item in history:
+        m = item["metrics"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"Trial {item['trial']} {item['kind']}: config={item['config']} "
+            f"test_mse={m['test_mse']:.6f} test_mae={m['test_mae']:.6f} "
+            f"val_loss={m['val_loss_final']:.6f} train_loss={m['train_loss_final']:.6f}"
+        )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def decide_with_qwen(history: list[dict[str, Any]], baseline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+
+    import os as _tpe_os
+    if _tpe_os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower() in {"tpe", "tpe_search", "bayesian", "bayesopt", "bayesian_optimization"}:
+        import sys as _tpe_sys
+        from pathlib import Path as _TpePath
+        _tpe_sys.path.insert(0, str(_TpePath(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+        from tpe_backend import tpe_decision_from_call
+        return tpe_decision_from_call(globals().get("TASK_ID", _TpePath(__file__).resolve().parent.name), locals(), globals())
+    backend = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower()
+    if backend in {"random", "random_search"}:
+        import random
+
+        seed = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_RANDOM_SEED", "0")
+        state = json.dumps(history, sort_keys=True, default=str)
+        rng = random.Random(f"{seed}:timexer_pjm_168_24_mse:{len(history)}:{state}")
+        raw = {key: rng.choice(list(spec["choices"])) for key, spec in SEARCH_SPACE.items()}
+        new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+        return {
+            "new_config": new_config,
+            "raw_new_config": raw,
+            "reasoning": "Uniform random sample from the constrained TimeXer search space.",
+            "confidence": 0.0,
+            "metadata": {"backend": "random_search", "seed": seed, "search_space_keys": sorted(SEARCH_SPACE)},
+        }
+
+    deps = ROOT / ".python_deps"
+    if deps.exists():
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(deps))
+    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
+    import torch
+
+    prompt = f"""You are choosing one hyperparameter configuration for a budget-limited reproduction benchmark.
+
+{training_log(history, baseline)}
+
+Search space:
+{json.dumps(SEARCH_SPACE, indent=2)}
+
+Return exactly one line:
+NEW_CONFIG: {{"d_model": 64, "d_ff": 64, "e_layers": 1, "patch_len": 24, "learning_rate": 0.0005, "batch_size": 128}}
+
+Choose the config most likely to reduce test_mse under the fixed 1-epoch budget. Do not change the dataset, seq_len, pred_len, epochs, model family, or metric."""
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if os.environ.get("AUTOREP_QWEN_NO_THINK", "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
+        prompt = prompt + "\n/no_think\nDo not output thinking. Return only the NEW_CONFIG line."
+    (OUT_DIR / "qwen_prompt_0.txt").write_text(prompt)
+    try:
+        from agenthpobench.agents.api_decision_client import api_backend_enabled, call_decision_api
+        if api_backend_enabled():
+            response = call_decision_api(prompt, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_API_MAX_TOKENS", "384")))
+            text = response.text
+            (OUT_DIR / "qwen_raw_0.txt").write_text(text)
+            try:
+                raw = parse_config(text)
+                new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+                metadata = {"api_backend": True, "api": response.metadata, "model_path": str(AGENT_MODEL)}
+                confidence = 0.7
+                reasoning = text
+            except Exception as exc:
+                raw = {"d_model": 64, "d_ff": 64, "e_layers": 1, "patch_len": 24, "learning_rate": 0.0005, "batch_size": 128}
+                new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+                metadata = {"api_backend": True, "fallback": True, "api": response.metadata, "error": str(exc), "raw_text": text[:1000]}
+                confidence = 0.4
+                reasoning = f"Fallback to short-budget probe-best config after API parse error: {exc}."
+            return {"new_config": new_config, "raw_new_config": raw, "reasoning": reasoning, "confidence": confidence, "metadata": metadata}
+    except Exception:
+        if os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_BACKEND", "").strip().lower() in {"api", "openai", "openai-compatible", "anthropic", "glm", "claude_code", "claude-code", "codex", "codex_cli", "codex-cli"}:
+            raise
+
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = os.environ.get("QWEN_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "1")
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(AGENT_MODEL), trust_remote_code=True, local_files_only=True)
+    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
+        str(AGENT_MODEL),
+        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device_map="auto",
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        local_files_only=True,
+    )
+    rendered_prompt = prompt
+    if os.environ.get("AUTOREP_USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE", "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"} and hasattr(tokenizer, "apply_chat_template"):
+        try:
+            rendered_prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
+        except Exception:
+            rendered_prompt = prompt
+    inputs = tokenizer(rendered_prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        output = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_AGENT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS", "1024")), do_sample=False)
+    text = tokenizer.decode(output[0, inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:], skip_special_tokens=True)
+    (OUT_DIR / "qwen_raw_0.txt").write_text(text)
+    try:
+        raw = parse_config(text)
+        new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+        metadata = {"direct_prompt": True, "model_path": str(AGENT_MODEL)}
+        confidence = 0.7
+        reasoning = text
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raw = {"d_model": 64, "d_ff": 64, "e_layers": 1, "patch_len": 24, "learning_rate": 0.0005, "batch_size": 128}
+        new_config = clamp_config(raw)
+        metadata = {"fallback": True, "error": str(exc), "raw_text": text[:1000]}
+        confidence = 0.4
+        reasoning = f"Fallback to short-budget probe-best config after parse error: {exc}."
+    del model
+    try:
+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    return {"new_config": new_config, "raw_new_config": raw, "reasoning": reasoning, "confidence": confidence, "metadata": metadata}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    baseline = run_eval("baseline", 0, BASE_CONFIG)
+    baseline_mse = baseline["metrics"]["test_mse"]
+    decision = decide_with_qwen([baseline], baseline_mse)

+

+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+import math
+import os
+import random
+from typing import Any
+
+LOWER_HINTS = ("loss", "mse", "rmse", "mae", "fid", "wql", "wape", "error", "nll")
+
+
+def _choices(spec: Any) -> list[Any]:
+    if isinstance(spec, dict) and "choices" in spec:
+        return list(spec.get("choices") or [])
+    if isinstance(spec, (list, tuple)):
+        return list(spec)
+    return []
+
+
+def normalize_search_space(search_space: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
+    return {str(k): _choices(v) for k, v in (search_space or {}).items() if _choices(v)}
+
+
+def _isnum(x: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(x, (int, float)) and not isinstance(x, bool) and math.isfinite(float(x))
+
+
+def infer_direction(task_name: str, training_log: str | None = None) -> str:
+    text = " ".join([str(task_name or ""), str(training_log or "")]).lower()
+    if "lower is better" in text or "lower_is_better" in text:
+        return "lower"
+    if "higher is better" in text or "higher_is_better" in text:
+        return "higher"
+    return "lower" if any(h in text for h in LOWER_HINTS) else "higher"
+
+
+def metric_from_dict(metrics: dict[str, Any], task_name: str = "", direction: str = "higher") -> float | None:
+    if not isinstance(metrics, dict):
+        return None
+    preferred = [
+        "validation_accuracy", "accuracy_percent", "test_accuracy_percent",
+        "math500_accuracy_percent", "reasoning_accuracy_percent",
+        "validation_scaled_sequence_accuracy", "scaled_accuracy", "test_auc",
+        "roc_auc", "f1_fake", "success_rate", "win_rate", "expected_reward",
+        "score", "val_loss", "fineweb10B_validation_loss", "MSE[0.5]",
+        "test_mse", "mse", "test_rmse", "rmse", "wape", "wql", "WQL",
+        "weighted_quantile_loss", "subset_diag_fid", "subset_fid", "mae",
+        "test_mae",
+    ]
+    lt = str(task_name).lower()
+    if "llm_c" in lt:
+        preferred = ["val_loss", *preferred]
+    if "uni2ts" in lt:
+        preferred = ["MSE[0.5]", *preferred]
+    if "timesfm" in lt:
+        preferred = ["wape", *preferred]
+    if "chronos" in lt:
+        preferred = ["wql", "WQL", *preferred]
+    if "var_" in lt:
+        preferred = ["subset_diag_fid", "subset_fid", *preferred]
+    for key in preferred:
+        if _isnum(metrics.get(key)):
+            return float(metrics[key])
+    numeric = [(k, float(v)) for k, v in metrics.items() if _isnum(v)]
+    for k, v in numeric:
+        lk = str(k).lower()
+        if not lk.startswith("num_") and "seconds" not in lk and "time" not in lk:
+            return v
+    return numeric[0][1] if numeric else None
+
+
+def _extract_observations(history: Any, task_name: str, direction: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    obs = []
+    if not isinstance(history, list):
+        return obs
+    for item in history:
+        config = None
+        value = None
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            config = item.get("config") or item.get("final_config") or item.get("agent_final_config")
+            value = float(item["value"]) if _isnum(item.get("value")) else None
+            if value is None:
+                value = metric_from_dict(item.get("metrics") or item.get("final_metrics") or item, task_name, direction)
+        elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            if len(item) >= 4:
+                metric_obj = item[1]
+                config = item[2] if isinstance(item[2], dict) else None
+                value = metric_from_dict(metric_obj, task_name, direction) if isinstance(metric_obj, dict) else (float(metric_obj) if _isnum(metric_obj) else None)
+            elif len(item) >= 2 and isinstance(item[1], dict):
+                value = metric_from_dict(item[1], task_name, direction)
+        if isinstance(config, dict) and value is not None and math.isfinite(value):
+            obs.append({"config": config, "value": float(value)})
+    return obs
+
+
+def _rank_observations(obs: list[dict[str, Any]], direction: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return sorted(obs, key=lambda o: float(o["value"]) if direction == "higher" else -float(o["value"]), reverse=True)
+
+
+def _density_choice(key: str, values: list[Any], good: list[dict[str, Any]], bad: list[dict[str, Any]], rng: random.Random) -> Any:
+    alpha = float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_ALPHA", "1.0"))
+    weights = []
+    for choice in values:
+        g = alpha + sum(1 for item in good if item["config"].get(key) == choice)
+        b = alpha + sum(1 for item in bad if item["config"].get(key) == choice)
+        weights.append(max(1e-9, g / b))
+    threshold = rng.random() * sum(weights)
+    acc = 0.0
+    selected = values[-1]
+    for choice, weight in zip(values, weights):
+        acc += weight
+        if acc >= threshold:
+            selected = choice
+            break
+    return selected
+
+
+def propose_tpe_config(
+    *,
+    task_name: str,
+    current_config: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    search_space: dict[str, Any],
+    history: Any = None,
+    training_log: str | None = None,
+    direction: str | None = None,
+    seed: str | int = "0",
+    decision_number: int = 0,
+    gamma: float | None = None,
+    explore_prob: float | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Fixed-budget BOHB-style policy with the same call signature as TPE.
+
+    The benchmark gives each intervention the same task-specific budget, so this
+    policy cannot allocate true multi-fidelity resources. Instead it mimics BOHB
+    behavior under the fixed budget: early trials explore randomly; later trials
+    promote configurations from the best observed rung and mutate them with a
+    TPE-style good/bad density ratio.
+    """
+    space = normalize_search_space(search_space)
+    current = dict(current_config or {})
+    if not space:
+        return current
+    direction = direction or infer_direction(task_name, training_log=training_log)
+    rng = random.Random(f"{seed}:{task_name}:{decision_number}:bohb")
+    obs = _extract_observations(history, task_name, direction)
+    explore_steps = int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_EXPLORE_STEPS", "2"))
+    if len(obs) < explore_steps:
+        return {k: rng.choice(v) for k, v in space.items() if v}
+
+    ranked = _rank_observations(obs, direction)
+    eta = max(2, int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_ETA", "3")))
+    n_good = max(1, math.ceil(len(ranked) / eta))
+    good = ranked[:n_good]
+    bad = ranked[n_good:] or ranked[:]
+    mutation_prob = float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_MUTATION_PROB", str(explore_prob if explore_prob is not None else 0.35)))
+    density_prob = float(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_DENSITY_PROB", "0.50"))
+
+    # Successive-halving style promotion: choose one of the best observed configs,
+    # with a mild rank bias, then mutate selected dimensions.
+    parent_weights = [1.0 / (rank + 1) for rank in range(len(good))]
+    parent = rng.choices(good, weights=parent_weights, k=1)[0]["config"] if good else current
+    proposal = {}
+    for key, values in space.items():
+        parent_value = parent.get(key, current.get(key))
+        keep_parent = parent_value in values and rng.random() >= mutation_prob
+        if keep_parent:
+            proposal[key] = parent_value
+        elif rng.random() < density_prob:
+            proposal[key] = _density_choice(key, values, good, bad, rng)
+        else:
+            proposal[key] = rng.choice(values)
+    return proposal
+
+
+def _pick_current(local_vars: dict[str, Any], global_vars: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    for name in ("current_config", "current", "config", "BASE_CONFIG"):
+        val = local_vars.get(name, global_vars.get(name))
+        if isinstance(val, dict):
+            return dict(val)
+    return {}
+
+
+def tpe_decision_from_call(task_name: str, local_vars: dict[str, Any], global_vars: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    seed = os.environ.get("AUTOREP_RANDOM_SEED", os.environ.get("AUTOREP_TPE_SEED", "0"))
+    decision_number = int(local_vars.get("decision_number", local_vars.get("trial_idx", len(local_vars.get("history", []) or []))))
+    search_space = global_vars.get("SEARCH_SPACE") or local_vars.get("search_space") or local_vars.get("SEARCH_SPACE") or {}
+    current = _pick_current(local_vars, global_vars)
+    history = local_vars.get("history") or local_vars.get("metrics_history") or []
+    training_log = ""
+    for name in ("training_log", "format_training_log"):
+        fn = global_vars.get(name)
+        if callable(fn):
+            try:
+                training_log = fn(history, current)
+            except Exception:
+                try:
+                    training_log = fn(history, local_vars.get("baseline", 0.0))
+                except Exception:
+                    training_log = ""
+            break
+    raw = propose_tpe_config(
+        task_name=task_name,
+        current_config=current,
+        search_space=search_space,
+        history=history,
+        training_log=training_log,
+        seed=seed,
+        decision_number=decision_number,
+    )
+    clamp = global_vars.get("clamp_config")
+    merged = {**current, **raw}
+    if callable(clamp):
+        try:
+            new_config = clamp(merged)
+        except Exception:
+            try:
+                new_config = clamp(raw)
+            except Exception:
+                new_config = merged
+    else:
+        new_config = merged
+    return {
+        "new_config": new_config,
+        "raw_new_config": raw,
+        "reasoning": "BOHB-style fixed-budget baseline promoted strong observed configurations and mutated them within the allowed discrete intervention space.",
+        "confidence": 0.0,
+        "raw_response": "BOHB-style fixed-budget baseline selected a configuration from the allowed discrete intervention space.",
+        "metadata": {
+            "backend": "bohb_style_fixed_budget",
+            "seed": str(seed),
+            "decision_number": decision_number,
+            "search_space_keys": sorted(normalize_search_space(search_space)),
+            "history_size": len(_extract_observations(history, task_name, infer_direction(task_name, training_log=training_log))),
+            "eta": int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_ETA", "3")),
+            "explore_steps": int(os.environ.get("AUTOREP_BOHB_EXPLORE_STEPS", "2")),
+        },
+    }
